{{Quest|Further Investigating Jake}} |location = [[Desert Settlement]] |location_page_description = Has suspicious about {{NPCSprite|Jake}}. |x = 163.5 |y = 77 |z = -359 |location2 = [[Underground Lab]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here after the player has accepted {{Green|4}} of their visiting offers on {{Zone|The Garden}}. |x2 = 174.5 |y2 = 26 |z2 = -477 |location3 = [[Underground Lab]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here after the player has accepted {{Green|5}} of their visiting offers on {{Zone|The Garden}}. |x3 = 173.875 |y3 = 28 |z3 = -498.5 |location4 = [[Underground Lab]] |location_page_description4 = Appears here after the player presses the lever in the first room of the lab, and before moving around to explore this second room. |x4 = 190.5 |y4 = 22 |z4 = -499.5 }} '''Beth''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Desert Settlement}}. She has a quest involving {{NPCSprite|Jake}}, where she and the player explore the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} and uncover {{NPCSprite|Jake}}'s secrets. The first visit there unlocks {{Item|Jake's Plushie}}, and the second visit, which requires unlocking the [[Greenhouse]] first, grants access to the [[Crop Analyzer]]. __TOC__ == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Jake's been working on something much bigger. &e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here? &8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up &e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this. &e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here? &e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore! &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics? &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7 &fhelp you. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust. }} |} ==Trivia == *'''Beth''' is one of the [[NPC]]s the player must talk to during the quest [[Quests#Talk to the Villager Inhabitants|Talk to the Villager Inhabitants]]. *After having '''Beth''' visit the player's [[The Garden|Garden]] {{Green|3}} times, the player can dig a block at {{Coords|175|42|-470}} in the {{zone|Glowing Mushroom Cave}} and find a hidden base. '''Bottle of Jyrre''' is a {{Rare}} item. After reaching {{Green|300}} bonus {{stat|int}}, it evolves into a '''Refined Bottle of Jyrre'''.

== Obtaining ==
'''Bottle of Jyrre''' has a {{Chance|1.68%|1|59.64|gifts}} chance to drop from opening {{Item|Red Gift}}s.

== Usage ==
=== Aging Item ===
A '''Bottle of Jyrre''' gains {{stat|int|1}} every hour that the player is online with it in their inventory, taking 300 hours to reach the maximum buff of {{stat|int|300}}. {{Aging Items Process}}

Upon reaching {{Green|300}} bonus {{stat|int}}, the '''Bottle of Jyrre''' evolves into a '''Refined Bottle of Jyrre''' with the following message.
{{Dialogue|&d&lEVOLUTION! &dYour &cBottle of Jyrre &dhas evolved!}}
Drinking a '''Refined Bottle of Jyrre''' grants {{statname|int|300}} for {{Green|1 hour}}, as well as permanent {{stat|int|+1}}. This can be done 5 times.

Like the {{Item|Lost Bottle of Jyrre}}, the '''Bottle of Jyrre''' can be drank before it evolves.

Trying to drink a second '''Bottle of Jyrre''' will result in the following message:
{{Dialogue|&cYou already have an active Bottle of Jyrre!}}

=== Crafting ===
{{Crafting Usage}}

== Calculator ==
{{Calculator:Bottle of Jyrre}}

== Trivia ==
*Jyrre is also an anagram of Jerry, which is the name's likely etymological origin.
*In a brewing stand, a '''Bottle of Jyrre''' acts much like a bottle of water, as it can be turned into an awkward potion using [[Nether Wart|nether warts]], which is not recommended.
*The NPC sell price does not increase until it becomes refined, unlike the {{Item|Lost Bottle of Jyrre}}.
*Drinking a '''Bottle of Jyrre''' will switch the player's hotbar slot one to the left, or if it's in the leftmost slot, one to the right, even if it fails due to one already being active.

{{Exclusive|Year/Seal}} {{Infobox/Item |rarity=e |source=[[Fishing]] |id = BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL |bazaar=BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL |auctionable=no }} A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' is an {{Epic}} item obtained from fishing. It is used to start a minigame about bouncing the ball to obtain {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s. == Obtaining == A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be obtained while {{Skill|Fishing}} anywhere during the [[Year of the Seal]]. It has a {{Green|25%}} ({{Green|1}} in {{Green|4}}) chance to replace a '''{{Purple|GOOD CATCH}}''' or '''{{Purple|GOOD}} {{DarkGreen|JUNK}} {{Purple|CATCH}}'''. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Treasure Chance ! Catch Chance |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|5|icononly=y}} | {{Green|1.11%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|89.9}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|15|icononly=y}} | {{Green|3.34%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|30.0}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|30|icononly=y}} | {{Green|6.68%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|15.0}}) |} When caught, the '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' grants {{Skill XP|+160 Fishing}}. == Usage == A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be used to start a minigame where the player must bounce the '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' off of their head continuously, where each bounce counts towards {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s. Up to {{Item|Fishy Treat|amount=20}}s can be obtained from a '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' after {{Green|40}} bounces. Any bounces past {{Green|40}} will provide no additional treats. A '''Bouncy Beach Ball''' cannot be used on the {{zone|Private Island}}, {{zone|The Garden}} or the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}. == Calculation == The number of treats received is calculated depending on the number of bounces, rounded down: {| class="wikitable centertext" |- ! Later in the quest, he appears in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}} with a {{Item|Small Backpack}}, after {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with finding the lost {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}}. Their [[Abiphone]] contact gets added to the player's Abiphone, instructing them to call upon finding the Apprentice. When this happens, he then walks up to the Apprentice with {{NPCSprite|Grelius}} and {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}, splashes him with healing potions, and then disappears, tasking the player player with reporting back to {{NPCSprite|Dean}}. Towards the end of the quest, {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with calling Captain Ahone, who then instructs the player to meet them by the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}. He can then be found there with several other [[NPCs]], who all agree to investigate [[Kuudra]]. This ending also occurs at the end of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. After defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time as part of either quest, they then appear in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} with {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} and {{NPCSprite|Elle}}, disappearing after you continue the quest. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#tuna_sandwich|tuna_sandwich]]" ([[#Catch a Fish|Catch a Fish]]) }} The {{Zone|Carnival}} is a [[Location]] on the {{Zone|Hub Island}} that appears when {{NPCSprite|Foxy}} is [[Mayor Election|elected]] with her {{Pink|Chivalrous Carnival}} perk: it contains minigames that reward {{Carnival Tokens}}, which can be spent from {{NPCSprite|Doug}} shop. Each minigame costs {{Item|Carnival Ticket|amount=5}}s to play, and rewards {{Carnival Tokens|1}} for every {{green|100}} points. {{ZoneText|Talk to the &aCarnival Leader&f.|Complete goals in various &eCarnival &fgames.|Upgrade seasonal perks.}} == Minigames == The '''Carnival''' currently features {{green|3}} different minigames. Each has its own designated game area, NPC, and a tool which players use to play. A minigame can be started by talking to an NPC responsible for that game. To start a game, the player must have an empty hotbar slot for the designated tool to be given. After playing, one can read their yearly and lifetime scores in each game by talking to {{NPCSprite|Chantelle}} near the entrance of the {{Zone|Carnival}}. {| class="wikitable" !Game !NPC !Location !Tool |- |Fruit Digging |{{NPCSprite|Carnival Pirateman}} |{{Coords|-107|73|-2}} |{{Item|Carnival Shovel}} |- |Zombie Shootout |{{NPCSprite|Carnival Cowboy}} |{{Coords|-103.5|70|8.5}} |{{Item|Carnival Dart Tube}} |- |Catch a Fish |{{NPCSprite|Carnival Fisherman}} |{{Coords|-81.5|72|-0.5}} |{{Item|Carnival Rod}} |} === Fruit Digging === The goal is to earn as many points as possible by using the {{Item|Carnival Shovel}} to dig up {{gold|Fruits}} scattered in a {{green|7}}x{{green|7}} grid of sand, within {{green|5}} minutes. *The grid consists of: ** {{green|34}} {{gold|Fruits}} of {{green|8}} different kinds, each with different points values and abilities; ** {{green|10}} {{Red|Bombs}} which destroy adjacentIn the context of '''Fruit Digging, '''"adjacent" means in a {{green|3}}x{{green|3}} grid. undiscovered {{gold|Fruits}}. ** {{green|5}} {{Yellow|Rums}} which disable the {{Item|Carnival Shovel}} ability for the next dig. * The {{Item|Carnival Shovel}} can dig {{green|15}} times. It has {{green|3}} '''dowsing''' abilities: ** {{Red|'''Mines'''}} tells how many {{red|Bombs}} are adjacent to the block dug. ** {{Aqua|'''Anchor'''}} tells the position of the lowest scoring {{gold|Fruit}} near the block dug. ** {{Orange|'''Treasure'''}} tells the highest scoring {{gold|Fruit}} adjacent to the block dug. {| class="wikitable sortable" ! {{gold|Fruit}} !! Points Given !! # Per Board !! Ability |- | Dragonfruit || 1200 || 1 || {{bc}} |- | Mango || 300 || 10 || {{bc}} |- | Coconut || 200 || 3 || Prevents a {{Red|Bomb}} from exploding for the next dig, if dug. |- | Apple || 0 || 8 || {{Green|+100}} points per {{Green|Apple}} dug OR blown up by Watermelon up to that point. |- | Cherry || 200 || 2 || {{Green|+300}} points per {{Green|Cherry}} dug OR blown up by Watermelon up to that point. |- | Pomegranate || 200 || 4 || Multiplies the points earned from the next dig by {{Green|1.5x}}.
If the next dig is Watermelon, the subsequently revealed fruit(s) are {{red|not}} multiplied. |- | Durian || 800 || 2 || Multiplies the points earned from the next dig by {{Red|0.5x}}.
If the next dig is Watermelon, the subsequently revealed fruit(s) are {{green|not}} multiplied. |- | Watermelon || 100 || 4 || Reveals a random {{gold|Fruit}} in a tile adjacent to itself (or a random tile if all adjacent tiles are destroyed/revealed): * granting {{red|0.5x}} of its point value and activating its ability, even if it is a Watermelon; * without consuming a use on the {{Item|Carnival Shovel}}. Its '''dowsing''' ability is used after the watermelon chain is revealed. |- |} === Catch a Fish === The goal is to catch as many {{cyan|Fish}} as possible using the {{Item|Carnival Rod}} within {{green|100}} seconds: *{{cyan|Fish}} spawn, swim erratically in a pond before despawning. They are caught by hooking onto them and holding {{Keypress|Right-Click}} to reel them until the progress bar above them fills. The progress bar fills at varying speeds with {{red|Red}} being the fastest and {{yellow|Yellow}} being the slowest. * {{gold|Catch Streak Bonus}}: {{Green|5}} bonus points are awarded per catch in a row, up to {{Green|50}} bonus points per catch. There is also a {{Green|10%}} chance to gain {{Orange|double points}}. This resets after failing to catch a fish or {{green|3}} seconds without hooking onto one. * The {{Item|Carnival Rod}} has infinite uses. * The player is immobile. {| class="wikitable" ! Fish Type !! {{Ahn|exclusive=yes}} {{Infobox/Character |dont_submit_to_bucket = Yes |location=Village |x=2 |y=77 |z=-5 }} '''Centauri''' is an [[NPC]] exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]]. They are located in front of the {{zone|Community Center}}, and grant {{c}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, item upgrades and update-featured items. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Usage == '''Centauri''' can be accessed by talking to them in the Hub, or via the {{code|/centauri}} command anywhere. The interface has three parts. === Featured Update Items === {{Quote|Claim featured items related to this update.}} This menu is a shop that sells items featured in an update for {{Coins|1}} each. === Coin Generator === This menu gives player any amount of money. Available options are: {{Coins|1k}}, {{Coins|10k}}, {{Coins|100k}}, {{Coins|1m}}, {{Coins|10m}}, {{Coins|100m}}, {{Coins|1b}}, and "Custom Amount". === Toy Box === {{Quote|A variety of useful and cheaty utilities to make your life easier!}} This menu contains other features available to the player. These features applies an effect to a player, and are claimable for any amount of times and without cool down. {| class="wikitable" ! Feature !! Description |- | Cookie Jar | When clicked, it gives the player the effect of a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Potion Seller | When clicked, it gives the player all potion effects of a {{Item|God Potion}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Max Items | When clicked, it makes the following changes to all armor pieces and items in the player's inventory (not including items in [[Storage]] and [[Wardrobe]]) if applicable: * Maximum [[Enchantments]] * [[Recombobulator 3000#Usage|Recombobulate]] * A fixed [[Reforge]] depending on the item's type, overriding any existing reforge on the item. If there is no set reforge for that category, the previous reforge, if any, stays on the item. Currently, this feature does not change any [[Gemstone]] slot on items. |- | Duplicate Items | When clicked when holding an item, it duplicates the item in the player's inventory. |- | Max Collections | When clicked, for all [[Collection]] items that has not reached its maximum tier, the collection amount is set to the requirement for the highest tier, meaning all tiers are unlocked. |- | Max Skills | When clicked, for all [[Skills]] that has not reached its maximum level except {{Skill|Dungeoneering}}, its skill XP is set to an arbitrarily high number, meaning all levels are unlocked. |- | Max Slayers | When clicked, all [[Slayer|Slayers]] are increased to their maximum level. |- | 50k HOTM EXP | When clicked, the player instantly gains 50,000 [[HotM Experience|HotM EXP]]. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Powder! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 2,000,000 [[Mithril Powder|Mithril]] and [[Gemstone Powder|Gemstone]] powder. |- | 5k Gems | When clicked, the player's [[Gems]] purse is set to {{Green|5,000}}. |- | Set RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player is prompted to enter an amount of XP for all the player's [[RNG Meter]]s progress to be set to. |- | Clear RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player's RNG Meters' progress is set to 0. |- | Fill Agatha's Rewards | Gives you rewards for [[Agatha]]'s contests as if you had participated in 25 of them. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Whispers! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 1,000,000 {{Turquoise|Forest Whispers}}. |- | Shards! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 10 of every available {{Item|Attribute Shard}}. |- |} ==== Reforges ==== '''Centauri''' applies the following reforges when using Max Items: {| class="wikitable centertext" |- ! Type ! Reforge |- | [[Armor]] | [[Ancient]] |- | [[Axe]] | {{bc}} |- | [[Bow]] | [[Precise]] |- | [[Equipment]] | {{bc}} |- | [[Fishing Rod]] | [[Treacherous]] |- | [[Pickaxe]]/[[Drill]] | {{bc}} |- | [[Sword]]/[[Fishing Rod|Fishing Weapon]] | [[Fabled]] |- | [[Wands|Wand]] | {{bc}} |} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Custom amount of {{c}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Oh? You have no idea of their power.}} |- | class="ct" | Duplicate Item | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: I solemnly swear I am up to no good.}} |- | class="ct" | Max Collections | rowspan="11" | Chocolate Eggs
source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic |title=Chocolate Egg |image=Breakfast Egg.png{{!}}Breakfast Egg¦Breakfast Egg.png{{!}}Brunch Egg¦Lunch Egg.png{{!}}Lunch Egg¦Lunch Egg.png{{!}}Déjeuner Egg¦Dinner Egg.png{{!}}Dinner Egg¦Dinner Egg.png{{!}}Supper Egg }} During [[Hoppity's Hunt]], '''Chocolate Eggs''' will randomly spawn around the world. They are announced in chat as they appear. == Mechanics == Players can search manually or use an {{Item|Egglocator}} to locate them. Once found, they can be clicked to claim a random [[Chocolate Rabbit]]. A total of 6 eggs can be active at once, two of each time of day. When a new egg appears, the oldest existing one will disappear. Egg locations are consistent between servers and spawn at 7 AM, 2 PM, and 9 PM [[SkyBlock Time]]. When the player finds a chocolate egg, one of the following chat messages will be displayed with the location depending on the type of chocolate egg: {| class="wikitable" !Chocolate Egg !In-game Spawn Time !colspan="3"|Real-world Spawn Time !Message |- |Breakfast Egg |rowspan="2" class="ct"|7 AM |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:00:50 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:20:50 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:40:50 |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &6Chocolate Breakfast Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Brunch Egg |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &6Chocolate Brunch Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Lunch Egg |rowspan="2" class="ct"|2 PM |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:06:40 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:26:40 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:46:40 |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &9Chocolate Lunch Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Déjeuner Egg |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &9Chocolate Déjeuner Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Dinner Egg |rowspan="2" class="ct"|9 PM |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:12:30 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:32:30 |rowspan="2" class="ct"|XX:52:30 |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &aChocolate Dinner Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Supper Egg |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &aChocolate Supper Egg &f[Location message]&d!}} |- |Hitman Egg |colspan="4" class="ct"|Rabbit Hitman |{{Dialogue|&d&lHOPPITY'S HUNT &r&dYou found a &cHitman Egg&d!}} |} === Hitman Egg === {{Main|Chocolate Factory#Rabbit_Hitman}} If any '''Chocolate Egg''' has been missed or skipped, a Rabbit Hitman will auto collect it to be opened later on as long as there is an available slot. After opening a Hitman Egg, {{Green|20}} minutes are added to the cooldown until it becomes available again. Hitman Eggs are able to collect unique location progress and [[Chocolate Rabbits#List_of_Rabbits|Resident Rabbits]] from other Islands. The cooldown can be redused by up to {{Green|25%}} from the {{Attr|Hitman Cooldown}} attribute. == Chocolate Rabbits == === Rabbit Chance === {{/Chance}} === Duplicate Rabbits === Having a full Rabbit Barn or getting duplicate Rabbits in the [[Chocolate Factory]] will give the player {{Chocolate}} based on the rarity of the Rabbit and the player's current Chocolate per Second. {| class="wikitable centertext" !Rarity !Base Amount
(seconds of production) |- |{{Common}} |150 |- |{{Uncommon}} |300 |- |{{Rare}} |750 |- |{{Epic}} |1,500 |- |{{Legendary}} |4,000 |- |{{Mythic}} |8,000 |- |{{Divine}} |15,000 |} In addition, each duplicate rabbit found gives {{Green|+10%}} of the base amount, up to {{Green|+100%}} at the 10th duplicate. Amount of [[Chocolate]] gained can also be increased with certain methods (additive): {| class="wikitable ct" ! Source ! Chocolate Boost |- |{{Item|Rabbit Pet|rarity=m}} |{{Green|33%}} |- |{{Light Purple|King}} Rabbit |{{Green|30%}} |} The formula is the following, where \text{Duplicates Found} is inclusive of the rabbit that you just found. Therefore, your first duplicate will already grant a 10% bonus on top of the base amount. \text{Chocolate Gained} = \text{Chocolate per Second} \times \text{Base Amount} \times (1 + \min(\text{Duplicates Found}, 10) \times 0.1) \times OtherMultipliers === Stray Rabbits === {{Main|Chocolate Factory#Stray Rabbits}} '''Stray Rabbit''' is guaranteed to appear in {{Green|30}} seconds after collecting an egg. It has a 10% (or {{Green|20%}} with {{Pink|Omega}} {{Mythic}} Rabbit) to be replaced with a [[Golden Rabbit]]. == Known Locations == All '''Chocolate Egg''' locations can be seen below. In-game, [[coordinates]] can be viewed by pressing {{Key|F3}} on the keyboard. {{CSB|id=locations|Show/Hide Locations}} {{CS|id=locations|mode=begin}} {{:Chocolate Eggs/List}} {{CS|mode=end}} == Trivia == * There are {{Green|10}} {{Common}} [[Chocolate Rabbits|chocolate rabbits]] which require claiming eggs at {{Green|15}} different spots in certain islands. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2024/April 9|version=none|Added '''Chocolate Eggs'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.20.1|Added '''Chocolate Eggs'''.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}}

In 2022, [[Simon]] appeared during the [[SkyBlock Anniversary|{{Pink|SkyBlock Anniversary}}]] near the {{zone|Colosseum}} to distribute '''Crab Hat of Celebration - 2022 Edition'''s, which were animated unlike their 2020 counterpart. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Message |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Collecting Crab Hat | class="ct" | 2020 |{{Dialogue|&eSimon gave a &7[color] Crab Hat&e to &7&e!}} |- | class="ct" | 2022 |{{Dialogue|&eSimon gave a &7[Color] Crab Hat of Celebration - 2022 Edition &eto &7&e!}} |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Attempting to claim another Crab Hat | class="ct" | 2020 |{{Dialogue|&eYou have already collected a hat for this year!}} |- | class="ct" | 2022 |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Simon: &fI've already given you a Crab Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!}} |} == Usage == {{:Hatcessories/Effect}} Additionally, the '''Crab Hat of Celebration''' gives the following cosmetic effect when worn: * Rainbow potion particles appear around the player. * Fireworks occasionally launch from the player's head. * For the 2022 Edition, the texture is animated. See [[#Gallery|§ Gallery]] below. == Trivia == * The color of the hat was randomly selected when it was claimed, like the [[Century Cake]] or the expression of [[Sloth Hat of Celebration]]. * The party hats worn by the crabs were white in 2020 and black in 2022. * Players can only acquire a Crab Hat on one [[profile]]. * Black Crab Hats are generally worth more on the [[Auction House]] because they are more visually pleasing, and the name blends in with the background in the tooltip. * The Crab Hats, [[Sloth Hat of Celebration|Sloth Hats]], and the [[Pulse Ring]] are the only [[Accessory|Accessories]] that give {{stat|mf}} without [[Enrichments]]. * As a {{Special}} accessory, the Crab Hat can be [[Enrichments|enriched]]. * When the 2022 edition was released, the stats, enrichments, and [[Accessory Power]] of different editions stacked with each other. ** The stacking has been removed since a certain point before Aug 19, 2022. * The amount of {{stat|int}} gained depends only on the number of [[Time|SkyBlock years]] that have passed since the player created their oldest profile, regardless of the player's activity during this time. The current maximum, which applies to players who joined during the first SkyBlock year, is {{SkyClock}}. * The Crab Hat was the first {{Special}} accessory. * Hatccessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". == Gallery ==

[[Heart of the Mountain]] Tier 4 |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Going Even Deeper|Going Even Deeper]]" |sublocations = *[[Jungle]] *[[Jungle Temple]] *[[Mithril Deposits]] *[[Mines of Divan]] *[[Goblin Holdout]] *[[Goblin Queen's Den]] *[[Precursor Remnants]] *[[Lost Precursor City]] *[[Crystal Nucleus]] *[[Magma Fields]] *[[Khazad-dûm]] *[[Fairy Grotto]] |resources = *Cobblestone *Coal *Iron Ingot *Gold Ingot *Lapis Lazuli *Redstone *Emerald *Diamond *Hard Stone *Mithril *Titanium *Dirt *Gemstone *Gemstone Powder *Oil Barrel *Golden Dragon Egg *Pickonimbus 2000 *Divan Fragment *Helix Fossil *Bob-omb *Treasurite *Jaderald *Prehistoric Egg *Divan's Alloy *Recall Potion *Ascension Rope *Wishing Compass *Mysterious Meat |prev_location = [[Dwarven Mines]] |mobs = *Kalhuiki Youngling *Kalhuiki Tribe Member *Kalhuiki Elder *Sludge *Key Guardian *Butterfly *Yog *Blaze *Bal *Scatha *Worm *Automaton *Grunt *Executive Sebastian *Executive Wendy *Executive Viper *Boss Corleone *Thyst *Sneaky Creeper *Lapis Zombie *Redstone Pigman *Emerald Slime *Miner Zombie *Miner Skeleton *Goblins *Water Worm *Poisoned Water Worm *Flaming Worm *Abyssal Miner *Lava Blaze *Lava Pigman }} The '''Crystal Hollows''' is a location that is focused on {{Skill|Mining}}. The primary focuses of the Crystal Hollows are mining [[Gemstones]] and collecting [[Gemstone Crystals]] to complete the [[Crystal Nucleus]]. {{ZoneText|Mine to your heart's content!|Mine new ores and fight new enemies!|Discover Crystals to earn rewards and forge Perfect Gems!}} == Overview == The '''Crystal Hollows''' consists of a large series of tunnels made of {{Item|Hard Stone}}, with veins of [[Gemstones]] and randomly-generated structures scattered throughout the caves. The tunnels themselves remain the same across lobbies, but the locations of structures will always be different across different servers. At the center of the '''Crystal Hollows''' houses the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}}, where [[Gemstone Crystals]] can be placed. Talking to {{NPCSprite|Gwendolyn}} allows you to purchase a pass to the '''Crystal Hollows''' for {{Green|6h}} for {{c|10k}}: you gain permanent, unrestricted access to the '''Crystal Hollows''' after helping {{NPCSprite|Dulin}}. === Mining === While inside the Crystal Hollows, '''broken ores and blocks are not replaced with bedrock.''' Instead, they will physically be broken be replaced with air, similar to vanilla ''Minecraft''. Blocks can be broken everywhere except the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}} and in specific structures: {{Item|Torch}}es, {{Item|Ladder}}s, {{Item|Hard Stone}}, and {{Item|Cobblestone}}, alongside [[Granite]], [[Andesite]], and their Polished Variants can also be placed. {{Item|Stone}} is replaced by {{Item|Hard Stone}} inside the '''Crystal Hollows''', which has a higher {{Stat|bp}} and a unique Collection. [[Gemstone]]s, {{Item|Mithril}}, and most Ores can spawn inside the Crystal Hollows. Ores that require a Furnace to be smelted into an ingot, such as {{Item|Iron Ore}} and {{Item|Gold Ore}}, do not require {{Ench|Smelting Touch}} or a Furnace to be converted to an ingot. Yields from most vanilla ores are increased within the Crystal Hollows. {| class="wikitable" |+Ore Yields !Icon !Ore !Base Yield |- |{{Slot|Coal Ore}} |Coal Ore |{{Item|Coal|amount=4-6}} |- |{{Slot|Lapis Lazuli Ore}} |Lapis Lazuli Ore |{{Item|Lapis Lazuli|amount=9-14}} |- |{{Slot|Redstone Ore}} |Redstone Ore |{{Item|Redstone Dust|amount=9-14}} |- |{{Slot|Emerald Ore}} |Emerald Ore |{{Item|Emerald|amount=4-6}} |- |{{Slot|Diamond Ore}} |Diamond Ore |{{Item|Diamond|amount=4-6}} |} == Zones == There are {{Green|5}} main locations in the '''Crystal Hollows''', being the {{Zone|Jungle}}, {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}}, {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}}, {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}}, and {{Zone|Magma Fields}}. These correspond to their respective [[Gemstones|Gemstone]], that being [[File:Rough Amethyst Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Amethyst]], [[File:Rough Jade Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Jade]], [[File:Rough Sapphire Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Sapphire]], [[File:Rough Amber Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Amber]], and [[File:Rough Topaz Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Topaz]]. [[File:Rough Ruby Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Ruby]] can also be found in the '''Crystal Hollows''' and can be found everywhere. Additionally, {{Green|3}} {{Zone|Fairy Grotto}}s spawn in random locations throughout the Crystal Hollows: [[File:Rough Jasper Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Jasper]] can be mined there. Each primary location has a sub-location, where its respective '''[[Gemstone Crystals|Gemstone Crystal]]''' can be obtained. * The {{Zone|Jungle}} contains the {{Zone|Jungle Temple}}, where a {{Item|Jungle Key}} must be given to access a series of parkour with the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} at the end; * The {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}} contains the {{Zone|Mines of Divan}}, where a {{Item|Metal Detector}} must be used to find and return [[Scavenged Items]], with the {{Item|Jade Crystal}} being rewarded at the end; * The {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}} contains the {{Zone|Lost Precursor City}}, where all {{Green|6}} [[Professor Robot|Automaton Parts]] or a {{Item|Precursor Apparatus}} must be given to access the {{Item|Sapphire Crystal}}; * The {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}} contains the {{Zone|Goblin Queen's Den}}, where any variant of [[Goblin Egg]] must be given to {{NPCSprite|King Yolkar}} the {{Item|Amber Crystal}} without being caught; * The {{Zone|Magma Fields}} contains {{Zone|Khazad-dûm}}, where {{MobSprite|Bal}} must be defeated to claim the {{Item|Topaz Crystal}}. '''Gemstone Crystals''' can be placed in the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}} to or used to forge '''Perfect Gemstones'''. You can see the status of Gemstone Crystals in the tablist: a Crystal can either be {{Red|'''Not Found'''}}, {{Yellow|'''Not Placed'''}}, or {{Green|'''Placed'''}}. A Gemstone Crystal must be found but {{Yellow|'''Not Placed'''}} to be used in the Forge to forge an its respective Perfect Gemstone. {{:Locations/Crystal Hollows}} == Treasure Chests == '''Treasure Chests''' exist in {{green|2}} types : '''Dug Chests''' and '''Structure Chests'''. They are found exclusively in the '''Crystal Hollows'''. They are the main way of gaining {{Gemstone Powder}}. {{Main|Treasure Chest}} ==Metal Detector Chests== '''Metal Detector Chests''' are exclusively found among the {{Item|Pure Gold}} coating the floor of the {{Zone|Mines of Divan}} using a {{Item|Metal Detector}}. They are relevant in obtaining the {{Item|Jade Crystal}}. {{Main|Metal Detector#Drops}} == Structures == {{Main|Crystal Hollows/Special Locations}} Each part of the Crystal Hollows has its own main special location, excluding [[Magma Fields]], which will almost always generate in every lobby: * The [[Jungle Temple]] generated in the [[Jungle]] * The [[Mines of Divan]] generated in the [[Mithril Deposits]] * The [[Goblin Queen's Den]] generated in the [[Goblin Holdout]] * The [[Lost Precursor City]] generated in the [[Precursor Remnants]] * 3 [[Fairy Grotto]]s generated anywhere within the Crystal Hollows Each of these structures house their respective [[Crystal Nucleus|Crystal]]. A special task must be completed to obtain the Crystal. [[Khazad-dûm]] is the one location that can spawn in any part of the Crystal Hollows, making it harder to find. There are also smaller structures which generate in random locations. Examples include: * A structure which resembles the [[Deep Caverns]], including the lift and the layered structure of the original Deep Caverns island * A dragon skull from the [[Spider's Den]] * A replica of the [[Dark Auction]] * A miniature version of [[The Forge]] including a working forge NPC * A copy of the pre-[[Hub]] overhaul [[Tavern]] A full list of Structures can be found at [[Crystal Hollows/Special Locations]]. Certain structures contain loot chests. Loot chests always generate in the same positions within the structures, similar to [[Dungeon Secrets]]. Loot Chests also generate the same items for every player, meaning if a player finds a chest with good loot such as a lot of Gemstone Powder or a Blue Goblin Egg, they can send the coordinates to chat to lead others to the chest. == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} ==Game Messages== {{Outdated|section=y|Add other game messages relative to the Crystal Hollows.}} ==Tips== {{Text anchor|Day Count|}} {{For|a tutorial on reading the '''Day Count''' of a world on Java Edition 1.21.9 and above|Tutorial:Day Count}} == Trivia == * The life of a '''Crystal Hollows''' lobby is determined by the following rules: ** On '''Day {{green|0}}''' (1st day), the lobby opens to players; ** On '''Day {{green|19}}''' (20th day), the lobby becomes locked, preventing new players from entering. Henceforth, if there are '''less than {{green|4}} players''', then the lobby will start shutting down. ** On '''Day {{green|35}}''' (36th day), the lobby will forcefully start shutting down regardless of player count. * The '''Crystal Hollows''' are internally referred to as the '''Greater Mines''' in the SkyBlock API. * The '''Crystal Hollows''' are the only place {{Item|Dirt}}, {{Item|Andesite}}, {{Item|Diorite}}, and {{Item|Granite}} (and other blocks) can be mined, however, only {{Item|Dirt}} drops itself and all others drop {{Item|Hard Stone}} instead. * [[Ores]] within a few blocks of the {{Item|Bedrock}} border may not get auto-smelted without {{Ench|Smelting Touch}}. * Attempting to get into the '''Crystal Hollows''' using an {{Item|Ender Pearl}} will result in the player being teleported out with the following message, even if they do have a valid Crystal Hollows Pass: *:{{Dialogue|&eYou have been teleported out of the &5Crystal Hollows &ebecause you did not have a valid pass!}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|ahn-0.12-r1|Added '''Crystal Hollows'''.}} {{History|unknown|Changed size of the '''Crystal Hollows''' from 1024 x 256 x 1024 to 621 x 157 x 621.}} {{History|unknown|Fixed all Polished Diorite blocks within the Crystal Hollows counting as Titanium and regenerating.}} {{History|2024/Aug 20|Increased entry requirement from [[Heart of the Mountain]] Tier III -> IV.|Removed {{Mithril Powder}} from Crystal Hollows treasure and loot chests.}} |beta= {{History|0.12|Added '''Crystal Hollows'''.}} {{History|2021/July 20|Updated Hollows map to improve navigation slightly.|Removed Ruby Skull Matching Puzzle room.|Fixed not being able to fish up certain Crystal Hollows sea creatures.}} {{History|2021/July 22|link=none|Updated Jungle Temple to make the parkour easier.}} {{History|2021/July 27|Added a 5 minute spawn protection area around entrances.|2 [[Fairy Grotto]]s will spawn per lobby rather than 1.|Improved warping to and from the Crystal Hollows.|Improved pass checks.|Reduced Powder amounts from loot chests.|Fixed loot chest spawning in some rooms.|Updated some rooms with context clues and spacing.}} {{History|2021/August [[File:Cult of the Fallen Star Screenshot.png|thumb|290x290px|The cult in the game]]
The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is a secret cult found in the {{zone|Cliffside Veins}} in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} at {{Coordinates|-45|193|45}}. To find the cult, players need to arrive between 0 AM and 6 AM in-game time on either the 7th, 14th, 21st or 28th day of each SkyBlock month. The entrance to the cult's cave is at {{Coordinates|-26|198|40}}. After going to a meeting, the player will obtain the {{ach|The Cult of the Fallen Star|ach=true}}.

After speaking to {{NPCSprite|Brarnas}} for the first time, players will be given the [[Fallen Star Helmet]]. In subsequent meetings with the cult, when the player wears the [[Fallen Star Helmet]], they will receive {{Item|Starfall|amount=200}}.

[[Silnar]] is also a member of the '''Cult''', who gives the player a [[Fallen Star Lozenge]].

== Location ==
The cult's cave is located in a hidden area of {{Zone|Cliffside Veins}}; specifically, it is west of the purple crystal and up the cliff. Players can use the lava channel in the {{Zone|Lava Springs}} to access the location without having to use ender pearls.

| class="ct" | First Meeting
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!

&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You said you never even saw the plates.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And I didn't! But &5Brarnas&f told me about it.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: No I didn't.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Anyways!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Try not to break those too.

&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, you should probably make yourself available.

&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Cat again?

&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yup, I sleep in one.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, &5 Thondin&f.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Huh?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: But it ''is'' a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: How can you be so sure?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Because everyone ''calls it'' a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Have you ever seen one turn?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Now that I think about it, no. I've neveer seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Me neither!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The same is true for me.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?

&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Don't be silly.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!}}

== Trivia ==
*Meetings, except for the gap between the meetings on the 28th and the 7th, are 7 in-game days apart (2 hours and 20 minutes in real life time).
*'''Dalir''' is the only cult member players can interact with.
*Despite the message saying "come back next time" if you forget to wear the helmet, you can simply put on the helmet and then talk to Brarnas again to receive the {{Item|Starfall}}.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is likely the antithesis to the [[Armor of the Rising Sun|Rising Sun]] as they share the same naming scheme.
*There is a [[Fairy Soul]] at {{Coords|-52|205|48}}, which is accessed from their room.
*'''Thondin''' states that his favourite food is blue pizza during cult meeting #6.
**The red and blue pizzas are a reference to [[w:The Matrix|The Matrix]]'s red pill and blue pill, where the red pill represents learning an unsettling truth, and the blue pill represents remaining in comfortable ignorance.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' members are one of 5 [[NPC]]'s to mention the "simulation" or the simulated state of the world of skyblock. Others include the [[Royal Resident]], [[Oen]], [[Yoshua]], and [[Skylark]].

[[Heart of the Forest]] Tier 4 |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Torrhus Canyon|Torrhus Canyon]]" |location = [[Torrhus Canyon]] |x = -610 |y = 43 |z = 244 }} The '''Desert Temple''' is a [[Location]] found on the {{zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. It can be accessed from the bottom of the {{Zone|Torrhus Springs}}, past the {{Zone|Spring Depths}}, and after completing a puzzle. {{ZoneText|The &bAltar &fof an ancient being.}} == Features == ===First Puzzle=== [[File:Desert Temple Entrance Puzzle.png|300px|thumb|The first puzzle, outside the temple]] The '''Desert Temple''' can be entered after completing a puzzle outside of it. It features 12 colored buttons and 5 colors on the bottom. Players must click the buttons in order of which colors appear least often to most often, which is {{Dark Aqua|Cyan}}, {{Yellow|Yellow}}, {{Red|Red}}, {{Color|brown|Brown}}, and {{Gold|Orange}}. ===Second Puzzle=== [[File:Desert Temple.png|300px|thumb|The second puzzle, inside the temple]] After entering the temple, another puzzle must be completed. It features a statue of a bird, a snake, a frog, and a fly. The statues can be rotated by clicking on them. They must be rotated so that: * The bird faces the snake, * The snake faces the frog, * The frog faces the fly, * and the fly faces away from the other statues, towards a wall. ===Temple Altar=== [[File:Desert Temple Altar.png|300px|thumb|The altar room, past the second puzzle]] Upon rotating the statues properly, a door will open, and the player will gain access to the Temple Altar, and permanently gain the passive effects from its {{Pink|Will}}. Players can donate to become a {{Blue|Benefactor}}, making [[Black Holes]] and [[Huntraps]] work {{Green|25%}} faster, and granting {{Stat|Hunting Fortune|2x}} from the {{Pink|Will}} bonus. Upon donating, the player will lose their status as a {{Blue|Benefactor}} of the {{Zone|Forest Temple}} if they were one, however, the time that this donation would have lasted will not be lost and rather added to the time as '''Desert Temple''' {{Blue|Benefactor}}. {|class="wikitable" ! {{Infobox/Location |location = Crimson Isle |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Blockjitsu|Blockjitsu]]" |level = {{Skill|Combat 22}} |npcs = Master Tao |x = -235 |y = 108 |z = -597 }} The '''Dojo''' is a collection of [[w:Minigame|Minigame]]s on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. The minigames can be completed by talking to {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} and achieving enough points. {{ZoneText|Master the trainings.|Compare your skills with other players.|Earn your &6Black Belt&f.}} == Location == The '''Dojo''' is in a secluded area on a small hill. To the left of the {{zone|Dojo}} is a small pool of lava, where players have a chance to fish up a {{Item|Karate Fish}}.
To get to the Dojo, there is a path leading to it, with small bells on stands scattered around the trail.

{{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} is the master of the {{zone|Dojo}}. He offers a selection of minigames, called tests. Each test is unique, as they all have different objectives.
Next to {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} there is a leaderboard showing the 10 Best Scores for each of the games. == Dojo Tasks == To begin a challenge, the player must speak to Master Tao. The player starts off with only the Test of Force unlocked. To start doing a challenge, the player must not have any items in their inventory or have armor equipped. Pets are disabled during a challenge. When a player starts a challenge, they will have a brief moment of blindness, before being teleported to the Dojo Arena. The [[SkyBlock Menu]] will be replaced with a {{Red|Cancel challenge}} item. The player can click with this item to leave the challenge at any point in time, however, canceling a challenge will be marked as a {{Red|fail}}. There is a leaderboard tracking the Top 10 best scores of each challenge. The player can toggle the leaderboard to show the top scores for each challenge. Scoring 1000+ (S) marks on any Dojo Challenge rewards SkyBlock XP, which increases [[SkyBlock Levels|SkyBlock Level]]. === [[File:Stick.png|24px]]Test of Force === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} Knock mobs into the lava.
{{Gold|2.}} Some mobs give more points than others.
{{Gold|3.}} Avoid negative point mobs!
The player spawns on a platform, where zombies spawn. The zombies do not damage the player. The aim of the challenge is for the player to hit as many zombies into the lava, without hitting negative point mobs. Zombies with iron helmets reward the player 10 points, zombies with gold helmets reward the player with 20 points, and baby zombies with diamond helmets reward the player with 30 points. The zombies also display how many points they give above their heads. Hitting a negative point zombie will subtract the points it removes from the player's current score.
=== [[File:Rabbit's Foot.png|24px]]Test of Stamina === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} Jump through the open holes in the moving walls.
{{Gold|2.}} Earn points by staying on the platform.
{{Gold|3.}} Don't get pushed into the lava!
The player spawns on a platform where moving walls cross it every few seconds. The challenge gets increasingly difficult, with the color of the walls changing respectively to the current difficulty. There are holes in through with the player must walk through or jump through. Getting pushed into the lava or touching the walls will end the challenge. The player earns points throughout the time they stay on the platform.
=== [[File:Bow.png|24px]]Test of Mastery === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} Shoot the targets before they disappear.
{{Gold|2.}} {{Green|Green}} targets are worth {{Green|8}} points.
{{Gold|3.}} {{Yellow|Yellow}} targets are worth {{Green|16}} points.
{{Gold|4.}} {{Red|Red}} targets are worth {{Green|32}} points.
The player spawns on a small platform, with a bow in their inventory. Surrounding the platform are wooden pillars, upon which Green wool spawns on. After a few seconds, the Green wool will become Yellow. After a few more seconds, the Yellow wool becomes Red, just for a few seconds before it disappears. The player must shoot these wool blocks to earn points. After 2 minutes, the challenge ends.
=== [[File:Diamond Sword.png|24px]]Test of Discipline === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} Hit the mob with the correct sword.
{{Gold|2.}} Every 30 seconds, gain a new type of sword.
{{Gold|3.}} Don't hit the mob with the wrong sword.
The player spawns on a large platform upon which zombies spawn. The player is automatically given a Wooden Sword. After some time, they are given an Iron Sword, then a Gold Sword and finally a Diamond Sword. The player must hit the correct zombie with the correct sword type. A zombie with a Leather Helmet must be hit with a Wooden Sword, a zombie with an Iron Helmet must be hit with an Iron Sword, a zombie with a Gold Helmet must be hit with a Gold Sword, and a zombie with a diamond helmet must be hit with a Diamond Sword.
=== [[File:Lead.png|24px]]Test of Swiftness === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} Temporary blocks will spawn to stand on.
{{Gold|2.}} If the block is red it'll disappear soon.
{{Gold|3.}} Don't stand around and fall into the lava!
The player spawns in a cage of barrier blocks, over a pool of lava. After a few seconds, the cage opens, and a block of green wool spawns. The player must stand on it. Green blocks keep on spawning, forming a snake-like pattern. After a block spawns, the previous one will turn orange, indicating it should not be stood on. After another block spawns, the orange block will turn red, indicating that it will disappear soon. After time, the task will be more difficult, with players having to jump 1- and 2-blocks across lava to reach the green wool.
=== [[File:Eye of Ender.png|24px]]Test of Control === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} Stare directly at a moving skeleton.
{{Gold|2.}} More accurate staring gives more points and time in the arena.
{{Gold|3.}} Don't look away for too long or fall in the lava!

=== [[File:Fireball.png|24px]]Test of Tenacity === Challenge Rules:
{{Gold|1.}} A ghast shoots fireballs at you.
{{Gold|2.}} Earn points by avoiding fireballs over time.
{{Gold|3.}} Don't trip and fall into lava!
The player spawns on a circular platform, with a ghast in one corner of the Arena area. The ghast will shoot fireballs at the player, which destroy the block they hit. After a certain amount of time, a message in chat will appear saying: {{Rmt|&eThe ghast is becoming more frustrated...}} Another ghast will spawn, and both will shoot fireballs at the player. After some more time, another ghast will spawn, and afterwards, another. The player will need to try and stay on the platform without falling into the lava for as long as possible. == Milestones == Achieving a large number of points rewards the player with [[Belt]] upgrades and {{skill|combat|XP}}. The [[Belts]] rewarded are {{Soulbound|Co-op}}. {| class="wikitable" !Milestone !Points

[[Profiles|Profile Management]] |{{Dialogue|&cYou cannot use the Profile Management Page during a challenge!}} |} == Tips == * When doing the Test of Mastery, DO NOT ignore red targets. Shoot those as much as possible. This can be done by checking your ping and shooting your arrows accordingly. For example, if you have 100ms Ping, then try to shoot your arrows when the targets are 0.1 seconds away from turning red. It is recommended to use mods to know when the target turns red. * There are 7 Tests and you need 7000 points to obtain the {{Item|Black Belt}}. ** 1000 points on each Test can be done, however, Points past 1000 still counts. You can offset low score on Tests you are having trouble on with Tests where you are competent at. == Trivia == *The background music for the Dojo is a note-block rendition of Club Penguin's dojo music. *The swords in the Test of Control come pre-enchanted with {{ench|Knockback 3}}, a normally unobtainable level. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|Added {{zone|Dojo}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|link=none|Added {{zone|Dojo}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}

To access her associated features, players must be at least {{SkyBlock Level|3}}. == Usage == {{Main|City Projects|Fire Sales|Account & Profile Upgrades|Booster Cookie|Bits}} '''Elizabeth''' has many different features in her menu, such as the option to see the most recent and all past [[City Projects]] and [[Fire Sales]]. Another feature is the [[Account & Profile Upgrades]] menu, where players can get bonuses for them on all of their [[profiles]], such as more {{Stat|MF}} and [[Ender Chest]] pages. The player can also get bonuses for all their co-op members on one profile, some for free (like [[Minion|Minion Slots]], some costing {{Gems}} such as [[Co-op|Co-op slots]]. Another menu allows players to receive {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=1}} for free and then purchase additional ones for {{Gems}}. The user can buy {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=1}} for {{Gems|325}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=6}}s for {{Gems|1950}}, or {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=12}}s for {{Gems|3900}}. In her menu is also located the Bits Shop, where players can use {{Bits}}, obtained using {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, to purchase various items. Most notably, the player can buy a {{Item|God Potion}} for {{Bits|1500}}, a {{Item|Kismet Feather}} for {{Bits|1350}}, {{Item|Pure Black Dye}} and {{Item|Pure White Dye}} for {{Bits|250000}}, and [[Enrichments]] for {{Bits|5000}} Her last menu lists the 5 commonly available [[Ranks]] on Hypixel and their perks: {{Rank|VIP}}, {{Rank|VIP+}}, {{Rank|MVP}}, {{Rank|MVP+}}, and {{Rank|MVP++}}. Furthermore, there is an item at the bottom of this page, as well as other pages, displaying your current {{Gems}}, {{Bits}}, and [[Fame Ranks|Fame Rank]]. After completing {{NPCSprite|Brigette}}'s account security quest, she gives the player a free {{Item|Booster Cookie}}. == Interface == {{Outdated|section=yes}} {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Below SkyBlock Level 3 |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dElizabeth&f: Hello! I hope you enjoy using it! }} |} == Account and Profile Upgrades == {{Outdated|{{Changelog|2026/April 8}} Changes to Skyblock Gem bundles resulting in an increase of cost}} These upgrades can be applied to either your current profile or your entire account. Some upgrades are free, while others require SkyBlock Gems to unlock. Each upgrade takes a certain amount of time to complete, but you can use SkyBlock Gems to skip the waiting. To fully upgrade everything to the maximum level, a player will need '''6,050 SkyBlock Gems'''. The total waiting time is '''382 real-world days''' for profile upgrades and '''244 days''' for account upgrades. You can choose to spend an additional '''80,904 SkyBlock Gems''' to skip the waiting period entirely. The cost will depend on the current value of SkyBlock Gems. ==== Upgrades per tier of gems bought: ==== {| class="wikitable" !Option !Bundle !Bundle Price !Gems per Pack !Packs Needed !Total Gems !Total Cost |- |1 |700 |$7.49 |93.46 gems/$ |9 |6,300 |'''$67.41''' |- |2 |1,800 |$18.74 |96.05 gems/$ |4 |7200 |'''$73.96''' |- |3 |3,750 |$37.49 |100.03 gems/$ |2 |7,500 |'''$74.98''' |- |4 |7,600 |$74.99 |101.35 gems/$ |1 |7,600 |'''$74.99''' |- |5 |17,000 |$149.99 |113.34 gems/$ |1 |17,000 |'''$149.99''' |} The best option is to buy 3 '''× 1,800 packs + 1 × 700 pack''' for a total of '''6,100 Gems''' at a cost of '''$61,67''' — but only if you plan to upgrade without skipping the waiting time. ==== Skipping time per tier of gems bought: ==== {| class="wikitable" !Option !Bundle !Bundle Price !Gems per Pack !Packs Needed !Total Gems !Total Cost |- |1 |700 |$7.25 |96.55 gems/$ |116 |81,200 |'''$841.00''' |- |2 |1,800 |$18.14 |99.23 gems/$ |45 |81,000 |'''$816.30''' |- |3 |3,750 |$36,29 |103.33 gems/$ |22 |82,500 |'''$798.38''' |- |4 |7,600 |$72.59 |104.70 gems/$ |11 |83,600 |'''$798.49''' |- |5 |17,000 |$145.19 |117.09 gems/$ |5 |85,000 |'''$725.95''' |} '''The best option''', '''considering''' you need the previous gems to upgrade and skip the waiting time, is to buy: 4 '''× 17,000 packs + 1 × 7,600 pack + 1 × 3,750 pack + 1 × 1,800 pack for a total of 6,300 Gems''' at a cost of '''$707.78'''. == Trivia == *The patch notes for the [https://hypixel.net/threads/5692280/ Better Mayors update] claim that "'''Elizabeth''' was too stubborn to move, so she is staying at the same location". Despite this claim, she actually moved 4 blocks. *On the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]], the Community Shop requires {{SBL|10}} instead of {{SBL|3}}. *When '''Elizabeth''' says "That's rough, buddy." during the Security Safety Quest; it appears to be a reference to Prince Zuko from ATLA. == Gallery == Elizabeth Scene.png|'''Elizabeth''' as seen in the Community Center. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved '''Elizabeth''' from {{Coords|-3.5|72|-101.5}} to {{Coords|-6.25|79|19.25}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|2026/March 23|Abiphone Contact reworked - no longer requires [[Abiphone Contacts Trio]] and enables being called whenever Account & Profile Upgrade finishes or a FIRE Sale starts.}} |beta= {{History|0.9|[[File:Elizabeth.png|26px]] Added '''Elizabeth'''.}} {{History|0.15|Changed '''Elizabeth'''{{'}}s dialogue from saying to go to the {{zone|Deep Caverns}} to talking about [[SkyBlock Levels]] if the player doesn't have access to the shop.}} {{History|0.16|Added [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Abiphone Contact}}]].}} {{History|2023/June 21|Fixed the city project button being empty when calling '''Elizabeth''' through an [[Abiphone]].}} {{history|0.19.1|Fixed Community Shop profile upgrade history not displaying the right player names.}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved '''Elizabeth''' from {{Coords|-3.5|72|-101.5}} to {{Coords|-6.25|79|19.25}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|0.24.3|Abiphone Contact reworked - no longer requires [[Abiphone Contacts Trio]] and enables being called whenever Account & Profile Upgrade finishes or a FIRE Sale starts.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

|x13 = -101.5 |y13 = 79.12 |z13 = -175.5 }} '''Elle''' is an [[NPC]] on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. She acts as a guide, and helps explain the new systems, factions and mobs there. == Quests == '''Elle''' is one of the main [[NPCs]] for the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] for both [[Factions]]. She first appears in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} trying to fight three {{MobSprite|Blaze (Elle's Quest);Blazes}}, after which she tasks the player with bringing her {{Item|Magma Chunk|amount=4}}, {{Item|Blaze Ashes|amount=3}} and {{Item|Spectre Dust|amount=2}}. After the player does this, '''Elle''' will start leaving the Stronghold. She will be in front of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} within {{Zone|Dragontail}}, and outside the {{Zone|Community Center (Scarleton)}} within {{Zone|Scarleton}}. She will then task the player with speaking to four [[NPCs]] from each [[Faction]], so that they can make their mind up about which one they want to join. The quest then splits depending on which faction was chosen. '''Elle''' is also required to access the Basic Tier of the [[Kuudra]] fight. {{Game Update}} {{Infobox/Mob |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 5,000,000 |defense = 150 |damage = 1,200 }} |category = Boss |spawn_location = [[Dragon's Nest]] |mob_level = 310 |mob_type = *{{mt|Construct}} *{{mt|Ender}} |mob_drops = *1-10 Enchanted End Stone *1 End Stone Rose *0-3 Crystal Fragment *0-1 Golem Pet *0-1 Tier Boost Core *0-1 End Stone Protector Shard |id = CORRUPTED_PROTECTOR_100 }} The '''End Stone Protector''' is a [[Mob]] and {{MobCategory|Boss}} that spawns in several locations in the {{Zone|Dragon's Nest}} after {{Green|5,000}} {{MobSprite|Zealot}}s are killed across the server. == Spawning == The '''End Stone Protector''' spawns in a number of predetermined locations in the {{Zone|Dragon's Nest}}. {{Green|5,000}} [[Zealot]]s must be killed in order to summon the boss. The '''End Stone Protector''' spawns in {{Green|5}} stages: * {{DarkGray|'''Resting'''}} - Phase 0 * {{Gray|'''Dormant'''}} - Phase 1 * '''Agitated''' - Phase 2 * {{Yellow|'''Disturbed'''}} - Phase 3 * {{Gold|'''Awakening'''}} - Phase 4 * {{Red|'''Summoned'''}} - Phase 5 This can be seen in the player's [[Tablist Widgets]]. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Message |- | class="ct" | {{Green|1,000}} {{MobSprite|Zealot}}s killed | {{Dialogue|&cYou feel a tremor from beneath the earth!}} |- | class="ct" | {{Green|5,000}} kills reached | {{Dialogue|&c&lThe ground begins to shake as an End Stone Protector rises from below!}} |} == Behavior == The '''End Stone Protector''' attacks the nearest player and rapidly swings its arms, tossing the player into the air and dealing damage. It only targets {{Green|1}} player at a time. The '''End Stone Protector''' also has {{Green|2}} abilities. * '''Toss:''' All nearby players who are on the standing on the ground are tossed into the air and take {{Stat|tdmg}}. * '''Crush:''' The '''End Stone Protector''' summons chunks of {{Item|Block of Iron|link=|text=Blocks of Iron}} in the air and crushes players with them, dealing {{InfoNeeded}} damage. Upon death, a platform constructed of {{Item|Block of Iron|link=|text=Blocks of Iron}} with a {{Item|Beacon|link=}} in the center is generated, similar to the platforms spawned by {{MobSprite|Ender Dragon}}s. Players can pick up loot here. == Drops == {{Mob Drops Table |level = 310 |coins = 775 |orbs = 930 |combat_xp = 2,325 }} The drops a player receives from killing an '''End Stone Protector''' are calculated based on their loot Quality, which is calculated with this formula: \text{Quality} = \text{BaseQuality} + \text{ZealotsKilled} + 50\cdot\frac{\text{PlayerDamageDealt}}{\text{FirstPlaceDamageDealt}}
Up to 100 killed Zealots will contribute to the player's Quality. Base Quality is determined by the damage placement of the player: {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Condition ! Base Quality |- | {{Green|1st}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|200}} |- | {{Green|2nd}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|175}} |- | {{Green|3rd}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|150}} |- | {{Green|4th}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|125}} |- | {{Green|5th}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|110}} |- |{{Green|6-8th}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|100}} |- | {{Green|9-10th}} in damage dealt |{{Aqua|90}} |- | {{Green|11-12th}} in damage dealt | {{Aqua|80}} |- | Below {{Green|12th}} in damage dealt
More than {{Stat|dmg|1}} dealt | {{Aqua|70}} |- | Below {{Green|12th}} in damage dealt
Less than {{Stat|dmg|1}} dealt | {{Aqua|10}} |} The place the player gets guarantees them certain drops: {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Condition ! {{Item|Enchanted End Stone}} ! {{Item|Crystal Fragment}} ! {{Item|End Stone Rose}} |- | {{Green|1st}} in damage dealt | 10 | 2 | rowspan="10" | 1 |- | {{Green|2nd}} in damage dealt | 7 | rowspan="4" | 1 |- | {{Green|3rd}} in damage dealt | 4 |- | {{Green|4th}} in damage dealt | rowspan="3" | 2 |- | {{Green|5th}} in damage dealt |- | {{Green|6-8th}} in damage dealt | rowspan="5" | 0 |- | {{Green|9-10th}} in damage dealt | rowspan="4" | 1 |- | {{Green|11-12th}} in damage dealt |- | {{Green|Below 12th}} in damage dealt
More than {{Stat|dmg|1}} dealt |- | {{Green|Below 12th}} in damage dealt
Less than {{Stat|dmg|1}} dealt |} Certain items can be dropped from the End Stone Protector if the player has enough Quality.

{{Update}} {{Infobox/Generic |image=Lapis Corpse.png }} '''Frozen Corpses''' are special entities found inside {{Zone|Glacite Mineshafts}} that can be interacted with to grant loot. They can be found in numerous positions, such as laying down, buried in ice, or buried in rock. == Spawning == '''Frozen Corpses''' can spawn in any [[Glacite Mineshafts|Glacite Mineshaft]]. Depending on the size, {{Green|1-3}} corpses will spawn: an additional '''Frozen Corpse''' can spawn in with [[Heart of the Mountain#Dead Man's Chest|{{AN|Dead Man's Chest}}]] ({{Green|+0.5}}-{{Green|25%}}) and {{Coll|Frozen Corpse Milestones 2}}-{{Coll|Frozen Corpse Milestones V}} ({{Green|+10}}-{{Green|20%}}), raising the maximum number of '''Frozen Corpses''' in a Glacite Mineshaft up to {{Green|4}}. == Types of Corpses == There are {{Green|4}} different kinds of '''Frozen Corpses''' that can generate in any given [[Glacite Mineshafts|Mineshaft]]. All Frozen Corpses need to be unlocked with certain Keys except for Lapis Corpses, which can be unlocked for free. {| class="wikitable" !Image !Type !Key !Spawn Chance !Base Loot |- | File:Lapis Corpse.png | class="ct" | {{Blue|'''Lapis'''}} |{{bc}} |{{Green|50%}} | {{Glacite Powder|500}}{{confirm}} {{HotM EXP|+100}} |- | File:Umber Corpse.png | class="ct" | {{Gold|'''Umber'''}} |{{Item|Umber Key}} |{{Green|25%}} | {{Glacite Powder|5,000}}{{confirm}} {{HotM EXP|+1,000}} |- | File:Tungsten Corpse.png | class="ct" | {{Gray|'''Tungsten'''}} |{{Item|Tungsten Key}} |{{Green|25%}} | {{Glacite Powder|5,000}}{{confirm}} {{HotM EXP|+1,000}} |- | File:Vanguard Corpse.png | class="ct" | {{Aqua|'''Vanguard'''}} |{{Item|Skeleton Key}} |{{Green|100%}} (while in the {{Dark Purple|Fairy mineshaft}}) | {{Glacite Powder|25,000}}{{confirm}} {{HotM EXP|+5,000}} |} If the [[Researcher Beryl|{{AN|Resourceful}}]] perk activates, the following dialogue displays: {{Dialogue|&6&lLUCKY! {{Exclusive|Year/Seal}} {{Infobox/Item |rarity=l |source=[[Fishing]] |auctionable=no |id = GIANT_BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL |bazaar=GIANT_BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL }} A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' is a {{Legendary}} item obtained from fishing. It is used to start a version of the {{Item|Bouncy Beach Ball}} minigame where multiple players can bounce the ball to earn {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s. == Obtaining == A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be obtained while {{Skill|Fishing}} anywhere during the [[Year of the Seal]]. It has a {{Chance|15%|1|6.66}} chance to replace a {{Mctxt|bold=true|6|GREAT CATCH}} or {{Mctxt|bold=true|6|GREAT}} {{Mctxt|bold=true|2|JUNK}} {{Mctxt|bold=true|6|CATCH}}. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Treasure Chance ! Catch Chance |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|5|icononly=y}} | {{Green|0.075%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|1,333.3}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|15|icononly=y}} | {{Green|0.225%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|444.4}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|30|icononly=y}} | {{Green|0.45%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|222.2}}) |} When caught, the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' grants {{Skill XP|+300 Fishing}}. == Usage == A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be used to start a minigame where the player must bounce the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' off their head or other player's heads as many times as possible within {{Green|60}} seconds. A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' cannot be used on the {{zone|Private Island}}, {{zone|The Garden}} or the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}. == Calculation == {{Sectionstub|Needs information on other numbers of participating players (up to 60).}} The player who launched the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' receives a number of {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s depending on the number of players who participated. Anyone else who participated receives {{Item|Fishy Treat|amount=1}}. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Participants ! The '''Grappling Hook''' is an {{Uncommon}} item. It is unlocked at {{CollectionLink|String IV}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Crafting Recipe Table
|{{Crafting Recipe Row
 |requirement = {{Coll|String IV}}
 |A1 = Enchanted String |B1 = Enchanted String |C1 = 
 |A2 = Enchanted String |B2 = Stick            |C2 = 
 |A3 =                  |B3 =                  |C3 = Stick
 |Output = Grappling Hook
 }}
}}

== Usage ==
The '''Grappling Hook''' has the model of a {{Item|Fishing Rod}}: casting it and reeling will fling the player towards the position of the bobber. It has a {{Green|2s}} cooldown. Using the '''Grappling Hook''' while it is on cooldown will display the following message:
{{Dialogue|&cWhoa! Slow down there!}}

The {{Item|Bat Person Armor}}'s {{AN|Bat Powers Activate!}} full set bonus removes the cooldown of the '''Grappling Hook''' and increases its power and range.

== Trivia ==
* By combining a {{Item|Grappling Hook}} with the {{Item|Spider's Boots}}'s {{AN|Double Jump}} ability, players can essentially fly.
** {{RN|Pig|Technoblade}} demonstrated this in his video "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vLLJAiII6p4 ''flying in skyblock'']".
* Due to the '''Grappling Hook'''{{'}}s cheap cost and early game accessibility, some aspects of the game are built with the assumption that the player has access to a '''Grappling Hook'''. 
** For example, many {{Item|Fairy Soul}}s are located in positions that require the use of mobility items such as the '''Grappling Hook''' to access.
* Unlike other mobility items such as {{Item|Aspect of the End}}, the '''Grappling Hook''' does not reset a player's downward speed, and as such will not prevent fall damage.
* Players can use a '''Grappling Hook''' while facing down or up to scale walls up to {{Green|5}} blocks at a time.
** Players can scale walls up to {{Green|11}} blocks with the {{Item|Bat Person Armor}} set bonus.
* Players can jump right before they grapple in order to increase the distance traveled.
* The '''Grappling Hook''' also appears as a gadget for Hypixel lobbies.
* As counter-intuitive as it sounds, players wishing to use the '''Grappling Hook''' and {{Item|Bat Person Armor}} who wish to cross long distances in the air should consider moving backwards while in the air before reeling their rod in, as the further the distance between the player and the bobber, the faster the player will move when they reel.

The '''{{zone|Graveyard}}''' is a [[Location]] on the [[Hub Island]] found past the {{Zone|Combat Settlement}} that features low-level {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s and a portal to the {{Zone|Spider's Den}}.

{{ZoneText|Fight Zombies.|Travel to the &cSpider's Den&f.|Talk to &7Pat&f.|Investigate the Catacombs.}}

== Purpose ==
The {{zone|Graveyard}} is home to {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s, which spawn in during the day, and more frequently at night. Additionally, {{MobSprite|Zombie Villager}}s that spawn exclusively and frequently at night.

The back of the '''Graveyard''' contains a launch pad to the {{zone|Spider's Den}}. There are also entrances to the {{Zone|Crypts}}, {{Zone|Catacombs Entrance}}, and {{Zone|Coal Mine}}.

=== Pat's House ===
[[File:Pat's House.png|thumb|Pat's House]]
There is a house near the entrance with {{NPCSprite|Pat}} inside who sells {{Item|Flint}} and {{Item|Gravel}}.

=== Emerald Altar ===
[[File:Emerald Altar.png|thumb|The Emerald Altar]]
The '''Emerald Altar''' is a mysterious altar located in the Graveyard. It consists of {{Item|Block of Emerald|amount=2|link=}} and {{Item|Lime Stained Glass|link=}}, making a spire in the center of 8 wide pillars surrounding the spire and thus making the altar. 

When the player tries to destroy the emerald block, the following message appears:
{{Dialogue|&cThe altar doesn't budge!}}

{{NPCSprite|Romero}} is found standing next to it during the 3rd phase of his quest, where he gives you the {{Item|Fake Emerald Altar}}.

=== Dante Memorial ===
[[File:Dante Memorial.png|thumb|The Dante Memorial]]
A memorial to {{NPCSprite|Dante}} exists at {{Coordinates|-84|76|-152}}. The stone pillar structure was added into the game during the 0.8.1 Hub revamp, while the {{NPCSprite|Dante}} statue and the memorial itself was added after [[The Uprising]]. Upon interaction with the stone statue of Dante, the following chat message appears:

<!-- Spelling errors are INTENTIONAL, as they appear so in-game!
-->{{Dialogue|
&7In Memoriam
&fWhile Dante will be remembered as a cruel tyrant, his righteous ideals live on in people's hearts.
&fdante &6best&7.
}}

I'll add you now. &e[NPC] &eJake&f: &b✆ &fBut don't call me after 8pm, please. }} |} == Tips == * Players can use [[Lead]]s, {{potN|Jump Boost Potion}}s, or [[Grappling Hook]]s to quickly climb up the mountain with an animal. ** The most consistent method is to use a [[Huntaxes|Huntaxe]] and [[Black Holes|Black Hole]]. Due to animals not having shards, they will float permanently into the black hole. You can move the black hole towards the mountain, taking as many animals as you wish at once. Move the black hole repeatedly until the animals levitate on top of the hut's roof. ** The classic method is to combine a lead with [[Spider's Boots]] or [[Tarantula Boots]] and double-jump to the very top. The animal will only take damage based on the distance from its highest point to the elevation of the spot it lands on, so it will take minimal damage only once when it lands on top of the mountain. The mana cost of these abilities can be reduced with a {{Item|Sheep Pet}} or {{Item|Tarantula Pet}}. ** Another method, although more difficult and expensive, is to use Spirit Boots to fly up the mountain. The boots will get you up the mountain in 2 flights because flights are very short. ** In order to get a Cow or Pig, it's recommended to land in the oasis to reset the potential fall damage before going up the mountain. *The Loch Emperor is not consumed from the summoning item after talking to Jake, meaning the player can unlock the Golden Ball item an infinite amount of times as long as they have the summon. == Gallery == File:Jake (Underground Lab).png|'''Jake''' while in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Crop Analyzer (Area).png|Crop Analyzer and '''Jake''' in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Jake's House (Render).png|[[Jake's House]] on top of the mountain == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 10|link=none|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|2026/July 15|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} {{History|2026/Oct 15|Moved '''Jake''' and his house from {{Coords|261.5|184|-565.5}} to {{Coords|245.5|95|-344.5}}.}} |beta= {{History|2021/April 21|[[File:Jake.png|26px]] Added '''Jake'''.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|0.26.1|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

&b✆ &2Junker Joel &fhas been added to your Abiphone's contacts! }} |} == Tips == *The best upgrade order for early game gear is generally the {{Item|Challenging Rod}}, followed by the equipment pieces of {{Item|Backwater Armor}}, and finally the armor itself. **{{Item|Salmon Armor}} provides better survivability, although {{Item|Backwater Armor}} provides higher {{Stat|scc}} and {{Stat|treasure chance}} for cheaper, along with increased damage against [[Sea Creatures]]. *Before obtaining a {{Item|Treasure Hook}}, equipping 2 pieces of {{Item|Bronze Hunter Armor}} or better will achieve a similar effect. == Trivia == {{Sectionstub}} * It cost {{Item|Rusty Coin|amount=1024}}, {{Item|Busted Belt Buckle|amount=124}}, and {{Item|Old Leather Boot|amount=12}}, along with {{Item|Bayou Water Orb|amount=1}} and {{Coins|10000}} to buy each items, with the exception of the {{Item|Treasure Bait}}. ** The {{Item|Hermit Crab Pet}} will cost an additional {{Item|Rusty Coin|amount=20}}, {{Item|Busted Belt Buckle|amount=8}} and {{Item|Old Leather Boot|amount=1}} to upgrade to {{Rarity|l|nolink=t}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Mar 12|[[File:Junker Joel.png|26px]] Added '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|2026/Mar 23|Added Abiphone Contact.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Removed {{Item|Travel Scroll to the Bayou}} from '''Junker Joel'''.|Reduced the {{Item|Rusty Coin}} cost of {{Item|Challenging Rod}} from {{Green|16}} to {{Green|8}}.}} |beta= {{History|2025/Mar 18|[[File:Junker Joel.png|26px]] Added '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|2025/Mar 19|Added {{Item|Treasure Hook}} to '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|0.24.3|Added Abiphone Contact.}} {{History|0.27.1|Removed {{Item|Travel Scroll to the Bayou}} from '''Junker Joel'''.|Reduced the {{Item|Rusty Coin}} cost of {{Item|Challenging Rod}} from {{Green|16}} to {{Green|8}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
