source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Armor |rarity = s |salable = n |auctionable = n |tradeable = n |soulbound = Solo |color = 35530A |all_colors_the_same = true |helmet_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_HELMET |chestplate_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_CHESTPLATE |leggings_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_LEGGINGS |boots_id = KUUDRA_FOLLOWER_BOOTS }} '''Kuudra Follower Armor''' is a {{Special}} [[Armor]] set. == Obtaining == === Helmet === {{See also|Kuudra Believer}} To obtain the Kuudra Follower Helmet, the player must have obtained the {{Item|Wet Napkin}} on their own, which can be fished up under the following conditions: * The player must use a lava fishing rod near the {{NPCSprite|Weird Sailor}} at {{Coords|-131|93|-177}} in the {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}. The Weird Sailor appears for a duration of 30 minutes after donating at least {{c|1m}} to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Believer}}. * The player must win a [[Kuudra]] fight right before approaching the {{NPCSprite|Weird Sailor}}. * The player must use [[Ice Bait]]. * The player must be wearing a full [[Elegant Tuxedo]]. * The player must be wearing a {{Item|Bonzo's Mask}} with {{Ench|Respiration I}}. There must also be a {{MobSprite|Plhlegblast}} within {{Green|3}} blocks of the Kuudra Believer. After meeting all these requirements, donating the number of {{coins}} given by the formula below to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Believer}} will allow the player to claim the Kuudra Follower Helmet. The number of {{coins}} is always in the range of {{c|13331070|13599850}}.
\text{Number of Coins} = 13331996 + 2\cdot\left(\text{Day of the Year in EST}\right)^2 - 58\cdot\left(\text{Player Name Length}\right)
''Day of the Year in EST'' is the number of days since 1 January of the current year, in UTC-5 (i.e. [https://www.timeanddate.com/time/zones/et Eastern Standard Time], ignoring Daylight Savings Time). For example, it would be 8 on January 8, or 44 on February 13. For {{#time:F j, Y|-5 hours}}, the number is {{#expr:{{#time:z|-5 hours}}+1}}.
''Player Name Length'' is the number of characters in the player's Minecraft player name. ==== Calculator ==== {{:Calculator:Kuudra Follower Helmet}} {{Coll S B|id=formula-explanation|name=Show/Hide Explanation of Formula}} {{Coll S| * The hint was from the tooltip of [[Wet Napkin]], which reads: "''The total {{Mctxt|k|--------}} plus time times time, all that subtracted from thrice the commencement, then add {{Mctxt|k|--}} of yourself, the whole thing elbuod.''" * ''The total {{Mctxt|k|--------}}'' means the total number of Netherrack blocks in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}, which is 21408112. * ''time times time'' means to multiply the current day of the year by itself. This uses Eastern Standard Time, the time zone of Hypixel's server. * ''thrice the commencement'' means three times the thread ID of the Crimson Isle release patch notes (https://hypixel.net/threads/4914038/), which is 4914038. Three times this is 14742114. * ''{{Mctxt|k|--}} of yourself'' means 29 times the number of characters in the Minecraft player name of the player claiming the helmet. The 29 comes from the number of hidden [[fandom:among-us:Among Us|''Among Us'']] characters scattered throughout the map art of the [[Wet Napkin]]. * ''the whole thing elbuod'' means to multiply the result by -2, since ''elbuod'' is the word ''double'' backwards. * Combining all of this, we get -2\cdot\left(3\cdot\left(4914038\right) - \left(21408112+\left(\text{Day of the Year in ET}\right)^2\right) + 29\cdot\left(\text{Player Name Length}\right)\right). * This simplifies to 13331996 + 2\cdot\left(\text{Day of the Year in ET}\right)^2 - 58\cdot\left(\text{Player Name Length}\right). |id=formula-explanation}} === Chestplate === {{See also|Arch}} To obtain the Kuudra Follower Chestplate, at least 6 players are needed. These 6 players must be wearing {{Item|Ember Armor}} or {{Item|Rekindled Ember Armor}}, and they must have a level 81 or higher {{Item|Kuudra Pet}} summoned. They must stand in pairs in the following locations. * 2 in the {{Zone|Stronghold}}. * 2 in the {{Zone|Dragontail Townsquare}}(They are recommended to get enough [[Factions#Reputation|Barbarian Reputation]] to prevent getting attacked by [[Barbarian Guard|Barbarian Guards]]). * 2 in the {{Zone|Scarleton Plaza}}(They are recommended to get enough [[Factions#Reputation|Mage Reputation]] to prevent getting attacked by [[Mage Guard|Mage Guards]]). The two players standing in the {{zone|Stronghold}}, as well as all other players on the server, can then speak to {{NPCSprite|Arch}} to claim the chestplate. === Leggings === {{See also|Kuudra Archeologist|Kuudra Relic}} To obtain the Kuudra Follower Leggings, a {{Item|Kuudra Relic}} is required. The [[Kuudra Relic]] can be obtained by following these steps: * Click the bookshelf at {{coordinates|10|127|-938}} in the {{zone|Cathedral}} while having at least {{stat|int|4000}}. * The following chat message will appear: {{Dialogue|&aYou use your mana to pull a book out. Most of it is unreadable but you do notice a 2 and a 22...}} * Right-click the block at {{coordinates|-373|82|-880}} inside the {{zone|Blazing Volcano}}. A menu will open for claiming the [[Kuudra Relic]] if the following requirements are met: ** The player must be holding a [[Drill]]. ** The volcano must be erupting with {{Volcano Activity|Cataclysmic}} explosivity. Note that explosivity can be seen in the tab menu. Showing the {{Item|Kuudra Relic}} to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Archeologist}} will allow the player to claim the Kuudra Follower Leggings. === Boots === {{See also|Kuudra Loremaster}} The Kuudra Follower Boots can be obtained by following these steps: * On the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}, the player must type in chat ''THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!'', ''Those orbs strengthen Kuudra! Shoot them down with your cannons!'', or ''A Dropship! Take it down before it's too late!'' to the {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Loremaster}}. * Travel to the {{zone|Deep Caverns}} and travel across the void to the old {{zone|Blazing Fortress}}. * Speak to the [[Kuudra Loremaster]]. The player will be able to claim the Kuudra Follower Boots if the following requirements are met: ** The player must have {{Item|Enchanted Magma Cream|amount=1024}} and {{Item|Enchanted Netherrack|amount=1024}} in their inventory. ** The player must have at least {{Green|1,000,000}} {{Coll|Netherrack}} collection. ** The player must have at least {{Green|1,000,000}} {{Coll|Magma Cream}} collection. *** The {{NPCSprite|Kuudra Loremaster}} will only show up on Tuesdays within a 24-hour time window. == Usage == Wearing the full set of '''Kuudra Follower Armor''' during a {{VA|cataclysmic}} eruption is required to unlock {{NPCSprite|Drakuu}}'s shop, in order to purchase the [[Kuudra Follower Artifact]]. == Tips == *It is highly recommended to splash {{PotN|Water Breathing 6}} on a {{MobSprite|Plhlegblast}} to keep it alive in the air, as the tier VI potion completely prevents its suffocation. ** Additionally, a {{PotN|Fire Resistance}} splash potion can help it survive fire/lava damage. *A {{Item|Lead}}, a {{Item|Fishing Rod}} for water, or a weak sword with {{Ench|Knockback 2}} (e.g. {{Item|Aspect of the Jerry}}) can help move the Plhlegblast. *The current faction of a helper for the {{ID|Kuudra Follower Chestplate{{!}}Chestplate}} is irrelevant. * Wearing [[Bat Person Armor]] with [[Reforging#Necrotic|Necrotic reforge]] during [[Spooky Festival]] is a budget way to effectively raise {{stat|int}}. The '''Sighted''' accessory power can also help reach the high intelligence requirement. *Using {{Item|Bat Person Talisman}}'s {{ability}} combining with {{Item|Spirit Sceptre}} can raise {{stat|int}} a little for several seconds, useful for when [[armor]], [[equipment]], and [[Accessory Power]] are still incapable to reach {{stat|int|4000}}. *Contributions from [[Co-op]] members count toward the collection requirements. == Trivia == * Kuudra Follower Armor is the only obtainable {{Special}} armor set. *Of all pieces, the {{ID|Kuudra Follower Chestplate{{!}}Chestplate}} is the easiest to obtain - the player to claim the piece doesn't require anything other than talking to Arch as long as there are 6 players helping, while other pieces require the player completing certain tasks on their own. * The lines for obtaining Kuudra Follower Boots were removed as it was the lines before the Kuudra fight revamp. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Kuudra Follower Armor'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Kuudra Follower Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Kuudra Follower Armor'''.}} {{History|2022/May 29|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Leggings.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Leggings''' are discovered.}} {{History|2022/June 28|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Boots.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Boots''' are discovered.}} {{History|2022/Sep 12|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Chestplate.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Chestplate''' is discovered.}} {{History|2022/Dec 18|link=none|[[File:Kuudra Follower Helmet.png|26px]] '''Kuudra Follower Helmet''' is discovered.}} {{History|0.17.2|Questline of {{Item|Kuudra Follower Leggings}} can now be advanced by any [[drill]] rather than only {{Item|Divan's Drill}}.|Reduced the amounts of collection required for {{Item|Kuudra Follower Boots}} from {{Green|5,000,000}} to {{Green|1,000,000}}.}} {{History|0.18.4|This quest can now be completed even if the player is muted on the Hypixel Network.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Armors}}

{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = uncommon |collection = Mushroom 4 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|2 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |auctionable = n |sell = 4 |raw_materials = *3x [[Planks]] *1x [[Red Mushroom]] *1x [[Brown Mushroom]] *1x [[Redstone Dust]] *1x [[Glowstone Dust]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Red Mushroom *1x Brown Mushroom *1x Redstone *1x Glowstone Dust |upgrades_to = Mystical Mushroom Soup |bazaar = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' is an {{Uncommon}} consumable item unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom|4}} that allows players to fly on their {{zone|Private Island}} and {{zone|The Garden}} for 2 minutes. You can also use it while guesting someone else's Private Island or Garden. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}. However, the flight duration is limited and you should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively. It functions the same as {{Item|Mystical Mushroom Soup}}, giving you the ability to fly on player islands for 2 minutes instead of 200 minutes, but materials to craft it cost only 1/160th of Mystical Mushroom Soup. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 4}} |A1 = |B1 = Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Red Mushroom |B2 = Brown Mushroom |C2 = Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Magical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Usage == When right-clicked, the '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' is consumed, triggering its ability. When consumed, the Magical Mushroom Soup gives the player 2 minutes of flight only on their [[Private Island]] and also makes them invulnerable to fall damage. When the effects are active, players will have multi-colored particles around them. If the player leaves the island when the Magical Mushroom Soup effects are still active, the timer will pause until the player returns to the island. The time of flight left can be extended by consuming additional soup. Warning messages will trigger when there is/are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Random Message |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming when
already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == *When Magical Mushroom Soup was added, there was a bug that allowed people to use the item on the [[Hub Island]]. It was fixed shortly after. *The texture of the Magical Mushroom Soup is based on the [[terraria:Grub Soup|Grub Soup]] from Terraria. *The Magical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. **The Nausea effect has been removed and Magical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. **The custom Magical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.4|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Magical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2019/June 29|Added a limit to how far you can fly away from your island.}} {{History|2019/August 2|Give Nausea effect for 1 less second.}} {{History|2020/June 2|Flight duration is now saved when leaving private islands. Limit of one hour of flight is lifted.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}

{{LiveCountdownBox|routine=A[D27 LSU Y88 -S] C[9mo -S / 3mo -S]|title=[[File:Mayor Election.png|30px|link=]] Mayor Election|subtitle=Election Period}} {{MayorWidget |headtext=yes |box_style=float:right; clear:right; margin-left:1em; }} :''Not to be confused with [[Chocolate_Rabbits#City_Rabbits|Mayor]] and [[Chocolate_Rabbits#City_Rabbits|Minister]], City Faction Rabbits.'' Mayors are [[NPC]]s that give global buffs and perks when elected by players. Mayor Elections were added in [[Changelog/2020/September 8|Hypixel SkyBlock's 0.9 Update]], with the first election taking place in {{green|SkyBlock Year 88}}. Since then, they happened regularly, with few exceptions caused by events related to {{NPCSprite|Dante}} and later {{NPCSprite|Aura}}. == Mechanic == === Elections === An election is held every SkyBlock Year ({{green|124 real-life hours}}) with {{green|{{green|5}}}} candidates. Players vote by entering the {{Zone|Election Room}} via the teleport pad in the {{Zone|Community Center}}, or calling {{NPCSprite|Clerk Seraphine}} on an [[Abiphone]], while the voting period is open. A player can cast their votes to {{green|1}} candidate per account, as opposed to per [[profile]], but they can change their chosen candidate anytime.Switching to a different profile will automatically cast the player's votes to the same candidate. If the Profile that is being switched to has fewer votes than the former, the amount of votes that candidate received is reduced accordingly. In the opposite case, players have to enter the menu again to add the additional votes to the total. * The amount of votes players can cast can be increased via: ** The player's [[File:Golden Helmet.png|21px|link=]] [[Fame Rank]]. ** {{Item|Voter's Badge}} and its upgrades. ** Doubled with the {{Item|Artifact of Control}}. ::The maximum votes a player can get is {{green|224 votes}}. * Perks Distribution, followed by Candidate Selection, will happen before an election opens (see [[#Perks_Distribution|sections below]]). * {{green|{{green|5}}}} candidates are revealed when the election starts on {{SkyDate|m=Late Summer|d=27th}} at 00:00. The election will end on {{SkyDate|m=Late Spring|d=27th}} 00:00 the following Year, at which point the candidate with the most votes will become the mayor. === Mayors and Ministers === {{Hatnote|"Ministers" redirects here, for the two onetime events tied to {{NPCSprite|Technoblade}} and {{NPCSprite|Aura}} where players were voted and chose unique perks see [[Resistance General]] and [[Minister Election]].}} * Out of the {{green|{{green|5}}}} candidates, the one with highest amount of votes will have all of their shown perks active until the end of the next election. * The leading candidate will become the Mayor and won't be able to participate in the following election. They will be stripped of their perks and one will be randomly selected the next time they appear. * The runner-up will become a Minister, activating their minister perk alongside the Mayor's perks. They will also be unable to participate in the following election, unless {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} has her {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk active. **{{pink|Special}} Mayors cannot be Ministers. If runner-up is a {{pink|Special}} Mayor, {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} will appear in a place of a Minister instead.{{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557150637152673843 |user=mrkeith |text= 
Are we correct to assume that when Special Mayor ends up second, there will be no Minister perk?
special mayors cannot be ministers. in this case you'll see Nancy}} **This also means that {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk doesn't work on {{pink|Special}} Mayors.{{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557160787661815859 |user=mrkeith |text= 
I guess doesn't hurt to ask, is there any special logic if Long Term Investment (the diaz perk) + minister nancy?
I think there will just be no LTI minister then, so the perk is void}} * If the elected Mayor is a {{pink|Special}} Mayor, there will be no Minister at all and {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} will appear in Minister's place in the {{Zone|Community Center}} as a placeholder. **In case of a tie, winning Mayor is determined by the candidate order.{{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557150637152673843 |user=mrkeith |text= 
What happens if 2 (or more) candidates in a mayor election have the exact same number of votes?
the heat death of the universe (its deterministic based on their candidate order)}} === Perks Distribution === All candidates have multiple possible perks — most commonly {{green|4}} perks, with {{NPCSprite|Paul}} and {{NPCSprite|Aatrox}} not being reworked into this system yet. Before an election, for all {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates (whether or not they are randomly chosen for the next election), perks are distributed in the following way: * If a candidate was elected and is running as mayor, they will have no chance to participate or gain a perk on the election. On the election they next appear in, they will reset to 1 random perk with no possibility to gain a perk. * If a candidate was not elected, all previous perks gained by that candidate are persistent (not wiped nor randomized in the future). Before the next election, whether or not they will participate the next election, they have a {{Green|50%}} chance to gain an additional perk. This chance is increased to {{Green|100%}} if they did not gain a perk in the last election they appeared in. * If a candidate was elected Minister, they will have no chance to participate in the next election unless {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} has her {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk active. However, all the perks they had up until that point are kept. {{green|1}} random perk of each candidate, except {{Pink|Special}} ones, is selected as Minister perk. This perk will be active even if the candidate ends up second. Minister perks are determined randomly and next time a candidate appears in an election, it may differ. A {{Blue|Regular}} Candidate can participate in an election with any number of their perks. A {{pink|Special}} and One-time Candidate always participate with all of their possible perks by default.Some of {{NPCSprite|Aura}}'s ministers disabled some of her perks. === Candidate Selection === The {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates are chosen randomly from the pool of all {{Blue|Regular}} candidates, except the one who is in the office as Mayor when the election starts. When no {{pink|Special}} Candidate runs, {{green|{{green|5}}}} {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates are chosen. Special candidates participate in an election not by random chance, but every [[Time Systems|{{green|8 SkyBlock years}}]] (when the SkyBlock Year is divisible by {{green|8}}, and become a mayor the Year after). * {{pink|Special}} candidates always appear on the {{Light Purple|rightmost}} in the Election Interface. * {{green|4}} other {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates are chosen. * {{pink|Special}} Mayors follow a set order {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} → {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} → {{NPCSprite|Jerry}} and then {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} again, this means that each {{pink|Special}} candidate shows up in an election every {{green|24 SkyBlock years}}. * Derpy broke this pattern twice: **in the {{Green|Year 128}} {{NPCSprite|Dante}} ran instead of him; **in the {{green|Year 464}}, {{NPCSprite|Aura}} was in office, which overwrote the standard election system. * Previous and Upcoming {{pink|Special}} mayors can be seen in the table below. {| class="wikitable" |+ class="txt-nowrap" | {{pink|Special}} Candidates Timetable (Speculated) |- ! Candidate !! Previous and Next Participation |- | {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} || {{SpecialNextParticipate|Derpy}} |- | {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} || {{SpecialNextParticipate|Jerry}} |- | {{NPCSprite|Scorpius}} || {{SpecialNextParticipate|Scorpius}} |} == Candidates == |-|Active Candidates= These Mayor Candidates may join current and upcoming mayor elections. === {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates === {{MayorList|Regular}} === {{pink|Special}} Candidates === {{MayorList|Special}} |-|Past Candidates= These Mayor Candidates participated elections in the past, but will not participate in future elections. === Retired {{Blue|Regular}} Candidates === {{MayorList|Retired_Regular}} === One-Time Candidates === {{MayorList|One-Time}} == Past and Present Elections == {{TextMessageBox |image=[[File:Jukebox.png|70px]] |text=See current and previous Elections, Results, and Statistics in detail on [[Mayor Election/Events]]. |box_color=blue }} {{TextMessageBox |image=[[File:Book and Quill.png|70px|link=]] |text=You may help by adding missing data on [[Module:Mayor/Elections/Data]] and [[Mayor Election/Alpha Hypixel Network]]. If it looks too difficult, please [[Project:Staff Assistance|find staff assistance]].
Note: The ''current Year'' is {{Clock|YYYYYY}}. The entry for election data should be the Year that ''an election takes place''. |box_color=blue }} == Interface == {{/UI}} == The Uprising == [[File:Dante Election Room.png|thumb|A Dante Election]] [[File:Dante Election Interface.png|thumb|Interface]] {{Main|Dante}} While {{NPCSprite|Dante}} was in the office after being elected, all following elections events scheduled in the [[Calendar and Events]] menu became temporarily canceled. {{Blue|Regular}} mayor elections were replaced with Dante Elections, in which all of the {{green|5}} candidates were replaced by Dante's clones — voting for any of them results in the vote being applied to all candidates. That means that the vote couldn't be changed and the election result was always {{green|100%}} for Dante. There used to be a bug where {{NPCSprite|Seraphine}} was the clerk present in the {{zone|Election Room}} instead of {{NPCSprite|Clerk Goon}}, however, it was fixed. {{Clear}} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable centertext" !Condition !Message |- class="article-row-main" |Casting/Changing a Vote |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&d&l{{Dashline}} &eYou voted for\/changed your vote to &d &ein the &bYear [#] Elections&e! &eAs a &b&e, your vote counts for &a[#]&e. &d &enow has &d[#]% &eof votes with &d[#] votes&e! &d&l{{Dashline}}}}
When hovering over the second line: {{Dialogue|&eIncrease your &bFame Rank &eby &espending &bBits &e\& &aGems &ein the Community Shop!}} |- class="article-row-main" |Casting/Changing a Vote with {{Item|Artifact of Control}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&d&l{{Dashline}} &eYou voted for\/changed your vote to &d &ein the &bYear [#] Elections&e! &eAs a &b&e, your vote counts for &a[#]&e. &8(doubled by &8Artifact of Control)&f. &d &enow has &d[#]% &eof votes with &d[#] votes&e! &d&l{{Dashline}}}}
When hovering over the second line: {{Dialogue|&eIncrease your &bFame Rank &eby &espending &bBits &e\& &aGems &ein the Community Shop!}} |- class="article-row-main" |Election Ends |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&d&k&lA &r&e&lEvent&r&e: &bMayor Elections ! &r&d&k&lA &eThe election room is now closed. Clerk Seraphine is doing a final count of the votes... &d&k&lA &r&e&lEvent&r&e: &bMayor Elections ! &r&d&k&lA &e is elected Mayor for the Year, &6gg&e! &a &ecame in 2nd and is the Minister, &6lesser gg&e! &eSeraphine counted votes from &b<#> &edifferent players. &eEverybody unlocks &6exclusive &eperks!}} |- class="article-row-main" |Trying to cast/change a vote
after the election has ended |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&cThis election has already ended!}} |} == On the Alpha Hypixel Network == Generally, when [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] opens, Mayor Elections are fully-functional and are held separately from the Main Server. === Mechanic === Mayor Elections on AHN run with the same principles, but independantly from those on the main server: * The results are counted separately, the candidates and their perks are picked separately. * The time that an Election starts and ends is in sync with the main server. * When the Alpha Hypixel Network is open, players can vote on its Mayor Election once per account (not per profile), regardless of whether they voted on the main server. ==== On an Alpha Network Reset ==== * At the time of a [[AHN#Alpha Network Reset|Network Reset]], {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} is the placeholder mayor for Alpha Hypixel Network until the next election. * If an election is supposed to be happening after a reset, the election feature will be disabled until the next election{{Confirm}}. See [[#Election Feature Disabled]]. ==== On a Session Opening ==== * When the Alpha Network closes and reopens without a Network Reset, all aspects of the Mayor Election will not be affected. * If an election is skipped during the downtime of the Alpha Network, it is unknown whether a random {{Blue|Regular}} candidate will be selected as mayor, or the previously elected mayor, or {{NPCSprite|Nancy}} being used as placeholder{{InfoNeeded}}. === Previous Elections === Due to the difficulty presented in recording Mayor Elections on the Alpha Hypixel Network which occasionally shuts down and reopens, it will be documented separately on [[Mayor Election/Alpha Hypixel Network]], and not integrated to the wiki's main table. == Features Disabled == === Mayor Disabled === There are some occasions during which a Mayor is disabled. This may happen when: * The previous mayor is not replaced after an election on a [[Hub]] server * The election feature is disabled on the Alpha Hypixel Network The following is the observed behavior: * When interacted, the "mayor" NPC will only give {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Mayor &f: Hello!!}} === Election Feature Disabled === On some occasions, the mayor election feature can be disabled on the Alpha Network. This is the observed behavior: * The Election Room is still present when votings happens in the main server. However, it will almost instantly teleport the player out when they attempt to get in. If there is enough ping, a player can interact with the NPCs and Ballot Box inside before it teleports you out. * Election is "closed". However, the timer outside the Election Room will still run in sync with the Main Server. * Ballot Box and Seraphine dialogue follows the version when election is closed. ** Attempting to click on the box in the middle of the {{zone|Election Room}} when the election is closed will show the message {{Dialogue|&cThe election booth is closed!}} ==Notes== * An election that starts during Year (Year X) will end during the next Year (Year X+1), as shown in the election interface ([[:File:Perks order can change.png|image proof]]). ** The election is always called "Election Year X". ** In each candidate, the sequence of a candidate's perks can change when a Year passes. However, the perks will not change. ** In each candidate, the number of years shown in "last elected" will increment when a Year passes. == Trivia == * {{NPCSprite|Derpy}} was the first candidate to have {{green|4}} perks. * {{NPCSprite|Technoblade}} is the only mayor to have {{green|5}} perks and technically {{green|11}} perks. * {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} becoming a mayor was leaked by Minikloon on [https://twitter.com/Minikloon/status/1346646061465690116?s=20 his Twitter]. Additionally, Dctr leaked the first perk, "Perkpocalypse" on [https://twitter.com/Dctrr/status/1347023274157486081?s=20 his Twitter] a day later. * {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}}'s Perkpocalypse does not include {{pink|Special}} mayors, candidates no longer participating or {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}. * Before [https://hypixel.net/threads/hypixel-skyblock-patch-notes-0-20-3-better-mayors.5692280/ 0.20.3] {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} had only 2 perks, one of which got removed and was replaced by 3 new ones. * {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}'s perk, "Shopping Spree" also applies to [[trades]]. * {{NPCSprite|Dante}} is the only candidate to swap perks after the election. ** Although, when elected, {{NPCSprite|Barry}} had a secret bonus to all of his perks. * Barry was first elected in Year 188, 100 SkyBlock Years after the first election, making him the mayor who went the longest time without being elected. ** {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} was another {{Blue|Regular}} candidate that had never been elected before. She was elected for the first time on June 30 2021, during the Year 146 Election, making her and Barry the two mayors who went the longest without being elected. * {{NPCSprite|Barry}} and {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} are the only candidates that buff damage. ** {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry;Jerry}} has +10% {{red|Combat}} and {{aqua|Miscellaneous}} stat boost. ** {{NPCSprite|Barry}} had +15% increased spell damage. * If no Mayor is elected for any reason, {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} will appear as a placeholder. * {{NPCSprite|Dante}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}} and {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}} are the only candidates that had unlisted perks that were revealed when elected. *No {{pink|Special}} mayor has ever lost an election. * In Year 241 an extra mayor was added to the mayor results with 0 votes. This was the new Mayor {{NPCSprite|Finnegan}} who was added in the 0.16.1 Update ([[:File:Mayor Finnegan 0 Votes.png|image]]) * There was a theory that when {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} is elected as Mayor with the perk Long Term-investment, and a {{pink|Special}} Mayor candidate is in 2nd place, the {{pink|Special}} Mayor would have no perks for the Year, and would show up with full perks the next Year. ** This was seemingly confirmed by {{RankName|Hypixel|TimeDeo}} after '''Diaz''' received 25% of the votes against '''Derpy''', according to {{RankName|YouTube|Derailious}}. source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = rare |collection = Mushroom 7 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|200 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |sell = 640 |bazaar = Mystical Mushroom Soup |raw_materials = 3 Planks *160 Red Mushroom *160 Brown Mushroom *160 Redstone *160 Glowstone Dust |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Enchanted Red Mushroom *1x Enchanted Brown Mushroom *1x Enchanted Redstone Dust *1x Enchanted Glowstone Dust |auctionable = n |upgrades_from = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = SUPER_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' is a {{Rare}} consumable unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 7}} that allows players to fly on [[Private Island]]s. == Usage == When consumed, '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' gives the player 200 minutes of flight on private islands. It also makes them invulnerable to fall damage while on their private island, which is useful when building farms. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a [[Booster Cookie]]. However, the flight duration is limited and one should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively, or else you will fall and take damage or possibly die. The flight duration can be extended by consuming additional soup. Mystical Mushroom Soup's duration will pause when leaving the island, resuming when one returns. Warning messages will trigger when there are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Obtaining == Mystical Mushroom Soup can be obtained through crafting. === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Mushroom 7}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Enchanted Red Mushroom |B2 = Enchanted Brown Mushroom |C2 = Enchanted Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Mystical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Random Message |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming when
already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == * This was announced by a former {{RN|a|Dctr}}, on June 4th, 2020. * Although it requires 160 times as many resources as [[Magical Mushroom Soup]], it lasts 100 times as long, making it a less efficient use of resources. * It was previously known as "Super Magical Mushroom Soup". * The max flight duration is about 596,523 hours, or 2,147,483,647 seconds, which is the 32-bit signed integer limit. This amount of soup would cost {{BZC|*33555 Oak Wood *178957 Enchanted Redstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Glowstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Brown Mushroom *178957 Enchanted Red Mushroom}}.  ** This record was discovered and reached by Cekofari. Upon reaching this limit, the flight duration timer disappears, flying gets disabled, and eating additional soup does not re-enable flight. The only known way to regain flight on the private island is to eat a booster cookie. *The first record was held by Zylenox, who had gotten 520,000 hours of flight, which he explained would last until he died in real lifehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6oatMZva0jU&t=85s. **The next record was held by MaybeMoshi who beat Zylenox's record with 521,001 hourshttps://hypixel.net/threads/mushroom-soup-record-broken.5342206/. **This record was ultimately broken by Cekofari when he hit the limit of 596,523 hours. * The Mystical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. ** The Nausea effect has been removed and Mystical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. ** The custom Mystical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/June 4|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/june-4-super-magical-mushroom-soup.2970703/|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Super Magical Mushroom Soup'''.|Renamed item to '''Mystical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Mystical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea Effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}

{{DISPLAYTITLE:Soulflow}} {{For|the item which grants {{Stat|soulflow|160}} when consumed|Soulflow (Item)}} {{Infobox/Stat |image=Soulflow (currency).png |uses = Abilities of some items, {{Stat|Overflow Mana}} Conversion |ways_to_increase = Consuming Soulflow Items: {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}}/{{Item|Raw Soulflow}} |symbol = ⸎ |unicode = U+2E0E }} {{Stat|Soulflow}}, or '''Internalized Soulflow''', is a player resource similar to {{Stat|mana}}. It is used to fuel powerful abilities from the [[Enderman Slayer]] and to generate {{Stat|overflow mana}}. == Obtaining == A player can obtain {{Stat|Soulflow}} by consuming the following Soulflow Items: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! {{Stat|Soulflow}} Granted |- | {{Slot|Raw Soulflow}} | [[Raw Soulflow]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Soulflow}} | [[Soulflow (Item)|Soulflow]] | 160 |} A minion will start producing Soulflow Items when equipped with the following Minion Upgrades: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Remarks |- | {{Slot|Lesser Soulflow Engine}} | [[Lesser Soulflow Engine]] | Produces {{Red|50% less}}
Produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} (Also {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} with {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}/{{Item|Dwarven Super Compactor}}) |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Engine}} | [[Soulflow Engine]] | Produces {{Red|50% less}}
Produces {{Item|Raw Soulflow}} (Also {{Item|Soulflow (Item)|text=Soulflow}} with {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}/{{Item|Dwarven Super Compactor}})
{{Green|+3%}} output when used on a {{MinionName|Voidling}} |} By consuming Soulflow Items, a player receives an amount of '''Internalized Soulflow''', which is also signified by the icon [[File:Soulflow (currency).png|13px|link=]]. Once consumed, there is no way to turn the {{Stat|Soulflow}} back into items. There is no known cap for the amount of Internalized {{Stat|Soulflow}} a player can have at once. == Usage == Internalized {{Stat|Soulflow}} is not displayed on the action bar, and can only be viewed on the tooltip of [[Soulflow Pile]] line accessories or in the Profile widget in the [[Tablist Widgets]]. Certain powerful abilities and items use {{Stat|soulflow}}: {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Item ! {{Stat|Soulflow}} Cost |- | {{Slot|Handy Blood Chalice}} | [[Handy Blood Chalice]] | 1 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Pocket Espresso Machine}} | [[Pocket Espresso Machine]] | 1 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Pile}} | [[Soulflow Pile]] | Up to 5 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Battery}} | [[Soulflow Battery]] | Up to 4 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Soulflow Supercell}} | [[Soulflow Supercell]] | Up to 4 when leaving combat |- | {{Slot|Etherwarp Conduit}} | [[Etherwarp Conduit]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Voidedge Katana}} | [[Voidedge Katana]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Vorpal Katana}} | [[Vorpal Katana]] | 1 |- | {{Slot|Atomsplit Katana}} | [[Atomsplit Katana]] | 2 |- | {{Slot|Final Destination Chestplate}} | [[Final Destination Armor]] | 2 per 5s in combat |- | {{Slot|Gloomlock Grimoire}} | [[Gloomlock Grimoire]] | 15 |- | {{Slot|Gyrokinetic Wand}} | [[Gyrokinetic Wand]] | 10 (Left Click) |- | {{Slot|Gyrokinetic Wand}} | [[Gyrokinetic Wand]] | 2 (Right Click) |- | {{Slot|Soul Esoward}} | [[Soul Esoward]] | 10 |- | {{Slot|Terminator}} | [[Terminator]] | 1 |} If insufficient {{Stat|soulflow}} is available, the abilities will not work. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Game Message |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" | Attempting to use an ability
without sufficient {{Stat|soulflow}} | {{Dialogue|&cNot enough soulflow!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&cnOt EnOuGh SoUlFlOw!}} |} == Trivia == * The symbol for {{Stat|soulflow}}, U+2E0E ⸎ "EDITORIAL CORONIS", is displayed as a lined diamond on some fonts and systems and a square root symbol on other fonts and systems. * The probability to receive the message {{Red|"nOt EnOuGh SoUlFlOw!"}} instead of {{Red|"Not enough soulflow!"}} is {{Chance|2%|1|50}}. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.11.5|Added {{Stat|Soulflow}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Stats}}

{{Infobox/Dungeon enemy |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 4-6 }} |category = Boss |mob_type = *{{mt|Cubic}} *{{mt|Arcane}} |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]] |special_behavior = Summons Spirit Animals |mob_level = 1 |description = {{gray|Shaman Necromancer}}
Powerful Necromancer who specializes in animals. Calls himself a vegetarian, go figure. |id = THORN_1, MASTER_THORN_1 }} {{For|the Enchantment {{Ench|Thorns}}|Thorns}} '''Thorn '''is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]]. He is a ghast which spawns animals and can only be damaged by his Spirit Bow. Thorn's remains re-appear on [[The Catacombs - Floor V|Floor V]], from which [[Livid]] drains energy in order to clone himself. == Collection == Killing Thorn increases the Thorn collection. {{CollectionTable|Thorn}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Overview === Unlike most of the other bosses in The Catacombs, Thorn only has one apparent phase, same as Livid, however technically has different phases, but the differences are minuscule. Thorn will speed up the more he has been damaged and when he is about to die in one more hit, Thorn will start turning around, making it harder to hit him. Additionally, with each wave that comes, the Spirit Animals gain more HP, overall making it a longer fight. After {{Green|15s}} of dialogue, Thorn will summon Spirit Animals which can deal damage to the player along with a new {{mcat|miniboss}} called the Spirit Bear. A counter (indicated by a ring of [[Sea Lantern]]s and [[Block of Coal|Coal Blocks]] near the audience) shows how many Spirit Animals have been killed. When the ring fully lights up with Sea Lanterns, the Spirit Bear will spawn. There is a crowd of enemies cheering for Thorn in the arena. While they can't attack the player, they can give helpful hints for Thorn's attacks. Although, if the player enters the crowds viewing area, swarms of spirit bats will attack the player and deal large quantities of damage. Occasionally, one of the circles in the arena will change color, either green or orange. If it turns green, it will ready up a Healing Circle much like the Healer's one, but if it turns orange, it will start a fire on that circle. Thorn's spirit animals will take 5% of their HP every second they are in the fire. === Spirit Bear === The Spirit Bear is a {{mcat|mb}} summoned during the fight. It will be summoned once 25 Spirit Animals (or 30 in Master Mode) have been killed. It has {{hp|5M}} (or {{hp|180M}} in Master Mode) and can attack players with a Golden Sword or a Spirit Bow. The spirit bear will heal overtime, but very slowly. When the Spirit Bear is killed, it drops a Spirit Bow. The player who picks it up only gets one chance to shoot Thorn. Each successful hit stuns Thorn for {{Green|5s}}, followed by a {{Green|1s}} cooldown before Thorn can be damaged again. Every hit from the Spirit Bow removes {{hp|1}} from Thorn’s health. Once Thorn’s health reaches zero, they die. === Summoned Mobs === Throughout the fight, various Spirit Mobs will spawn in. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bull}} - These rush towards the player to attack them. They also have a charge attack, dealing {{Red|30%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in regular mode ({{Stat|Damage|846.6|icononly=yes}}) and {{Red|75%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|53,550|icononly=yes}}). * {{MobSprite|Spirit Wolf}} - These will swarm players and attack them in large quantities. They deal {{Red|3.5x}} damage to players using the [[Tank]] [[Class]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bat}} - These will swarm players who are in the air. They do not respect player invincibility frames. This means if a player jumps in the air and is swarmed by bats, they will be mowed to death in seconds. Can be deterred by decoys as they have no vanilla attacking ability and cannot destroy it. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Rabbit}} - These will attack the player, launching them in the air, and then run away. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Chicken}} - These slowly descends to the ground, strike nearby players with lightning. If it touches the ground, it will turn into a Chicken Mine. Players who walk over it take damage and are knocked into the air. The lightning attacks deal {{Red|1.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|1,392|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode, and {{Red|0.35x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|9,408|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Sheep}} - These run toward the player and explodes like a creeper. This deals up to {{Red|0.2x}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}}, or {{Stat|Damage|3,808|icononly=yes}} in regular mode and {{Stat|Damage|133,280|icononly=yes}} in [[Master Mode]], with the amount depending on close the player was to the explosion.{{Confirm}} {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bear}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bull}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Wolf}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bat}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Rabbit}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Chicken}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Sheep}} }} == Drops == Killing Thorn will complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Master Mode Loot}} == Dialogue == === Thorn === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro |{{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Welcome Adventurers! I am Thorn, the Spirit! And host of the Vegan Trials! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Today you'll be our spectacle. &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Dance! Dance with my Spirit animals! And may you perish in a delightful way! }} |- | class="ct" | Attempting to attack {{MobSprite|Thorn}} without using a {{Item|Spirit Bow}} | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: I'm already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - I am Thorn the Spirit! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Trying to damage me like that...desperate... }} |- | class="ct" | After being damaged with a {{Item|Spirit Bow}} | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: I feel...dizzy... &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: It hurts...what a delicate feeling... &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Round and round, another wound. &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: My energy, it goes away... }} |- | class="ct" | Spawning a wave | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Go my Spirits, go! Gooooo!!! &bCROWD&f: Vegan power! &bCROWD&f: More chickens!!! &bCROWD&f: Dolphins are my spirit animal. Too bad this is 1.8. &bCROWD&f: Thorn! Thorn! Thorn! &bCROWD&f: Kill (random player), they are ugly! }} |- | class="ct" | Upon player death | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: Yeahhh!!!! You got 'em! &bCROWD&f: Another one bites the dust!! You the best Thorn! &bCROWD&f: Wow! (player) is bad! &bCROWD&f: (player) couldn't handle Thorn's onslaught! Yikes!! }} |- | class="ct" | Upon damaging {{MobSprite|Thorn}} for the first time | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: BOOOOO!!! &bCROWD&f: Keep fighting Thorn! Show them!! &bCROWD&f: Cheaters!!! We need a replay!! &bCROWD&f: That wasn't fair!! He can't fight back!! &bCROWD&f: That's not a legal move! &bCROWD&f: I see they've figured out how to damage Thorn. Finally. }} |- | class="ct" | Failing to pick up the {{Item|Spirit Bow}} | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: They didn't even pickup the Spirit Bow! Whoopsies! &bCROWD&f: They're not even trying to win! &bCROWD&f: LOL! Pickup the Spirit Bow next time you fools! &bCROWD&f: Are they blind?! The Spirit Bow just sat there untouched! }} |- | class="ct" | Upon missing {{MobSprite|Thorn}} after firing the {{Item|Spirit Bow}} | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: (player) missed the shot! No way!! Keep dodging them Thorn! &bCROWD&f: (player) has no thumbs! }} |- | class="ct" | If all players have lost | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: They lost!! HURRAY! &bCROWD&f: Pathetic performance. Loved it!! &bCROWD&f: Come back any time! Just kidding, you CAN'T!! &bCROWD&f: Thorn go brrrrrrr &bCROWD&f: Fs in the chat! &bCROWD&f: POG }} |- | class="ct" | If all players have won | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: Whatttt? How did they win?? &bCROWD&f: I need a refund!! &bCROWD&f: Why do the good guys always win!! &bCROWD&f: This game is UNBALANCED!!! &bCROWD&f: I hope you get terrible loot! Booooo!! &bCROWD&f: You won't beat the next floor anyways!! &bCROWD&f: Where is the arbiter? That wasn't right... &bCROWD&f: Make it a best of 3, best of 3!!!! &bCROWD&f: Thorn was lagging! Not fair! &bCROWD&f: There was a bug...rematch!!! &bCROWD&f: There is no justice in this world... &bCROWD&f: Remember Bonzo! #NeverForget &bCROWD&f: My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined. &bCROWD&f: I shouldn't have put so many Coins on this match.. &bCROWD&f: Where is watchdog when we need it?? &bCROWD&f: I'm reporting them right now! &bCROWD&f: Not coool...not cool. &bCROWD&f: Those people are so rude. I feel sorry for Thorn. &bCROWD&f: Killing a spirit...what kind of man does that? ... No man at all. &bCROWD&f: Lame!!! Boooo!!! &bCROWD&f: Nooo! You can't just beat Thorn! &bCROWD&f: Pack it up boys...nothing to see here... &bCROWD&f: Another 2020 catastrophe. &bCROWD&f: OOF }} |- |} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Thorn}} == Trivia == *The [[Spirit Bow]] used in the Thorn fight has some extra lore attached to it. {{Slot|Spirit Bow}} *Thorn's remains are seen in during the [[Livid]] boss fight in the form of a purple orb (|''This Orb you see, is Thorn, or what is left of him.''"). *The Spirit Bow specifically does approximately {{stat|dmg|75,000}} per hit against Thorn. *One of '''Thorn''''s lines is "Round and round, another wound." which might have been intended to rhyme, even though it does not. *The dialogue of '''Thorn's''' crowd contains many references. **"''Another 2020 catastrophe.''" references the [[w:COVID-19|COVID-19 pandemic]]. **"''Killing a spirit...what kind of man does that? ... No man at all.''" references ''Breaking Bad'', in which Gustavo Fring asks Hector Salamanca "''What kind of man talks to the DEA? No man, no man at all.''" **"''Avenge Bonzo! #RememberBonzo''" and "''Remember Bonzo! #NeverForget''" references {{MobSprite|Bonzo}}, the boss of [[The Catacombs - Floor I]], hinting that the two are connected. Notably, Bonzo is a circus clown and Thorn hosts a performance. **"''My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined.''" references the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/my-disappointment-is-immeasurable-and-my-day-is-ruined quote of the same name], in which host of TheReportOfTheWeek, Reviewbrah, says the exact quote after tasting Popeyes' cheddar biscuit butterfly shrimp. **''"Fs in the chat!''" is a reference to the meme [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/press-f-to-pay-respects originating from 2014's Call of Duty Advanced Wafare], where there is an event in the campaign where you have to "Press F to pay respects", which eventually has been used by gamers in the event of a huge loss. ==Tips== *There is currently a bug that allows players can stun '''Thorn''' in place using a {{Item|Tribal Spear}} or {{Item|Bonemerang}}. This is commonly used by players to make the bossfight easier. **Attempting to stun '''Thorn''' but failing the stun whilst Thorn is still alive will make '''Thorn''' will become extremely fast. This is because when '''Thorn''' gets hit with the [[Tribal Spear]] or [[Bonemerang]] it treats it like he got hit with the [[Spirit Bow (Thorn)|Spirit Bow]] which increases his speed. **The {{Item|Terminator}}'s "{{an|Salvation}}" ability can also cause him to reach this state but it is much more difficult, since the ability can only be cast after landing {{green|3}} hits with the bow. == Gallery == Thorn Orb.png|'''Thorn'''{{'}}s remains during the [[Livid]] boss fight == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/July 30|[[File:Thorn.png|26px]] Added '''Thorn'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]

The '''Validus Glyph''' is an {{Epic}} Quest Item obtained in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Validus Glyph''' can be obtained by starting {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}'s quest and then opening the chest at {{Coords|-57.5|70|-95.5}} by the pond in the {{Zone|West Village}}. Once given to Okron, it can no longer be obtained.

{{/UI}}

== Usage ==
The '''Validus Glyph''' can be given to {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}. When given, he will task the player with using the {{Item|Warding Diamathame}} to imbue a spell onto the house.

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Beth&f: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh... my... what is all of this?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThese aren't normal &acrops&f. These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
&8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
&e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7<player> &fhelp you.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7<player>&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust.
}}

== Usage ==
A '''Black Hole''' can be placed down to draw in nearby [[Mobs]]. Having lower {{Stat|hp}} causes the '''Black Hole''' to pull it in stronger. Once an eligible [[Mob]] has less than {{Stat|hp|10%}} and is within range, the '''Black Hole''' can catch it to gain its [[Attribute Shard]]. '''Black Holes''' despawn after {{Green|180}} seconds and can have the timer reset by catching a [[Mob]].

Additionally, the {{Item|Medium Pocket Black Hole|text=Medium}} and {{Item|Large Pocket Black Hole}}s grant {{Stat|Hunting Fortune|+2.5|icononly=yes}} and {{Stat|Hunting Fortune|+5}} for Combat Shards respectively.

== Tips ==
* '''Black Holes''' are best paired with [[Huntaxes]], due to them preventing fatal blows.
* When capturing a mob, the '''Black Hole''' will play an animation lasting {{green|2}} seconds for each level of [[Rarity]] of the shard being captured. For example, an {{Rarity|Epic}} shard would take {{green|8}} seconds to capture. The '''Black Hole''' cannot capture another mob during this animation and shortly after it ends.
** This animation can be shortened in the following ways:
*** {{Attr|Hunter's Pressure}} attribute by up to {{Green|50%}} ({{Green|60%}} with {{Attr|Echo of Hunter}}, {{Green|65%}} with {{Attr|Echo of Hunter}} and {{Attr|Echo of Echoes}})
*** {{Item|Accretion Talisman}}, {{Item|Accretion Ring}} and {{Item|Accretion Artifact}} by {{Green|5%}}, {{Green|10%}} and {{Green|15%}} respectivelly.
*** [[Desert Temple]] {{Blue|Benefactor}} bonus by {{Green|25%}}
** The delay after finishing a capture can be skipped by immediately placing down the '''Black Hole''' again.
* Due to the {{Attr|Hunter’s Grasp}} attribute increasing the {{Stat|Hunting Fortune}} of Black Holes by up to {{Green|13%}}, using Black Holes can yield more [[Attribute Shard]]s than other methods of hunting the same mob.

== Trivia ==
* '''Black Holes''' cannot be placed in the [[Catacombs]]. Attempting to do so will issue the following message:

n''' is an [[Accessory]] that upgrades based on the player's [[SkyBlock Level]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Book of Progression''' can be claimed in the Leveling Rewards menu after reaching {{SkyBlock Level|25}}. After being obtained, it can be bought from {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} for {{C|100k}}.

== Upgrading ==
The '''Book of Progression's''' [[Rarity]] will be upgraded at the following levels:
* {{SkyBlock Level|25}}: {{Common}}
* {{SkyBlock Level|75}}: {{Uncommon}}
* {{SkyBlock Level|150}}: {{Rare}}
* {{SkyBlock Level|225}}: {{Epic}}
* {{SkyBlock Level|300}}: {{Legendary}}
* {{SkyBlock Level|400}}: {{Mythic}}

The player can select one of 3 abilities to use:
* '''Stacked Healing''' (Unlocked at {{SkyBlock Level|25}}): When being healed, heal {{Blue|+X%}} the amount.
* '''Defensive Strongman''' (Unlocked at {{SkyBlock Level|50}}): When you are attacked, take {{Blue|+X%}} less of the incoming damage.
* '''Extra Infliction''' (Unlocked at {{SkyBlock Level|75}}): When you deal damage, deal {{Blue|+X%}} the amount.

The bonus amount is {{Green|0.01%}} per {{SkyBlock Level}}, up to {{Green|5%}} at {{SkyBlock Level|500}}.

Selecting an ability costs {{C|500}} multiplied by the player's {{SkyBlock Level}}.

<math>\text{Bonus} = 0.01 \times \min(\text{SkyBlockLevel}, 500)</math>

<math>\text{Cost} = 500 \times \text{SkyBlockLevel}</math>

== Trivia ==
*The price of this item at {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} is not affected by the {{Item|Shady Ring}} and its upgraded versions.
*The '''Book of Progression''' cannot normally be [[Recombobulator 3000|recombobulated]]. However, if it is done anyway (e.g. using {{NPCSprite|Centauri}}), it will revert to its intended rarity. This can lead to it being a {{Common}} item that visually appears recombobulated, as well as the following message in chat:
*:

The '''Cake House''' is a sub-location of the {{zone|West Village}} in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Features ==
The '''Cake House''' features a few attractions.

=== House ===
There '''Cake House''' is full of {{Item|Cake|link=}}, which can be eaten to navigate through the house. There are two floors, with a staircase joining the two together. Every single block of air is replaced by Cake, and each one has {{Green|7}} slices, which once are completely eaten, clears the space entirely.

== Zones ==
There are {{Green|5}} main locations in the '''Crystal Hollows''', being the {{Zone|Jungle}}, {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}}, {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}}, {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}}, and {{Zone|Magma Fields}}. These correspond to their respective [[Gemstones|Gemstone]], that being [[File:Rough Amethyst Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Amethyst]], [[File:Rough Jade Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Jade]], [[File:Rough Sapphire Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Sapphire]], [[File:Rough Amber Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Amber]], and [[File:Rough Topaz Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Topaz]]. [[File:Rough Ruby Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Ruby]] can also be found in the '''Crystal Hollows''' and can be  found everywhere. Additionally, {{Green|3}} {{Zone|Fairy Grotto}}s spawn in random locations throughout the Crystal Hollows: [[File:Rough Jasper Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Jasper]] can be mined there.

Each primary location has a sub-location, where its respective '''[[Gemstone Crystals|Gemstone Crystal]]''' can be obtained.
* The {{Zone|Jungle}} contains the {{Zone|Jungle Temple}}, where a {{Item|Jungle Key}} must be given to access a series of parkour with the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} at the end;
* The {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}} contains the {{Zone|Mines of Divan}}, where a {{Item|Metal Detector}} must be used to find and return [[Scavenged Items]], with the {{Item|Jade Crystal}} being rewarded at the end;
* The {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}} contains the {{Zone|Lost Precursor City}}, where all {{Green|6}} [[Professor Robot|Automaton Parts]] or a {{Item|Precursor Apparatus}} must be given to access the {{Item|Sapphire Crystal}};
* The {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}} contains the {{Zone|Goblin Queen's Den}}, where any variant of [[Goblin Egg]] must be given to {{NPCSprite|King Yolkar}} the {{Item|Amber Crystal}} without being caught;
* The {{Zone|Magma Fields}} contains {{Zone|Khazad-dûm}}, where {{MobSprite|Bal}} must be defeated to claim the {{Item|Topaz Crystal}}.

'''Gemstone Crystals''' can be placed in the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}} to or used to forge '''Perfect Gemstones'''. You can see the status of Gemstone Crystals in the tablist: a Crystal can either be {{Red|'''Not Found'''}}, {{Yellow|'''Not Placed'''}}, or {{Green|'''Placed'''}}. A Gemstone Crystal must be found but {{Yellow|'''Not Placed'''}} to be used in the Forge to forge an its respective Perfect Gemstone.

{{:Locations/Crystal Hollows}}

== Treasure Chests ==
'''Treasure Chests''' exist in {{green|2}} types : '''Dug Chests''' and '''Structure Chests'''. They are found exclusively in the '''Crystal Hollows'''. They are the main way of gaining {{Gemstone Powder}}.
{{Main|Treasure Chest}}

==Metal Detector Chests==
'''Metal Detector Chests''' are exclusively found among the {{Item|Pure Gold}} coating the floor of the {{Zone|Mines of Divan}} using a {{Item|Metal Detector}}. They are relevant in obtaining the {{Item|Jade Crystal}}.
{{Main|Metal Detector#Drops}}

== Structures ==
{{Main|Crystal Hollows/Special Locations}}
Each part of the Crystal Hollows has its own main special location, excluding [[Magma Fields]], which will almost always generate in every lobby:
* The [[Jungle Temple]] generated in the [[Jungle]]
* The [[Mines of Divan]] generated in the [[Mithril Deposits]]
* The [[Goblin Queen's Den]] generated in the [[Goblin Holdout]]
* The [[Lost Precursor City]] generated in the [[Precursor Remnants]]
* 3 [[Fairy Grotto]]s generated anywhere within the Crystal Hollows
Each of these structures house their respective [[Crystal Nucleus|Crystal]]. A special task must be completed to obtain the Crystal.

[[Khazad-dûm]] is the one location that can spawn in any part of the Crystal Hollows, making it harder to find.

There are also smaller structures which generate in random locations. Examples include:
* A structure which resembles the [[Deep Caverns]], including the lift and the layered structure of the original Deep Caverns island
* A dragon skull from the [[Spider's Den]]
* A replica of the [[Dark Auction]]
* A miniature version of [[The Forge]] including a working forge NPC
* A copy of the pre-[[Hub]] overhaul [[Tavern]]
A full list of Structures can be found at [[Crystal Hollows/Special Locations]].

Certain structures contain loot chests. Loot chests always generate in the same positions within the structures, similar to [[Dungeon Secrets]]. Loot Chests also generate the same items for every player, meaning if a player finds a chest with good loot such as a lot of Gemstone Powder or a Blue Goblin Egg, they can send the coordinates to chat to lead others to the chest.

== Trivia ==
* The life of a '''Crystal Hollows''' lobby is determined by the following rules:
** On '''Day {{green|0}}''' (1st day), the lobby opens to players;
** On '''Day <u>{{green|19}}</u>''' (20th day), the lobby becomes locked, preventing new players from entering. Henceforth, if there are '''less than {{green|4}} players''', then the lobby will start shutting down.
** On '''Day {{green|35}}''' (36th day), the lobby will forcefully start shutting down regardless of player count.
* The '''Crystal Hollows''' are internally referred to as the '''Greater Mines''' in the SkyBlock API.
* The '''Crystal Hollows''' are the only place {{Item|Dirt}}, {{Item|Andesite}}, {{Item|Diorite}}, and {{Item|Granite}} (and other blocks) can be mined, however, only {{Item|Dirt}} drops itself and all others drop {{Item|Hard Stone}} instead.
* [[Ores]] within a few blocks of the {{Item|Bedrock}} border may not get auto-smelted without {{Ench|Smelting Touch}}.
* Attempting to get into the '''Crystal Hollows''' using an {{Item|Ender Pearl}} will result in the player being teleported out with the following message, even if they do have a valid Crystal Hollows Pass:
*:

Attempting to use this helmet without the required {{Motes|100}} or {{c|1k}} will display a message saying: {{Dialogue|&c&lWEIRD FLEX!&c Unequipped Flex Helmet because you cannot afford it!}}After this, the '''Flex Helmet''' will be automatically sent to inventory, or to stash if it's full.

=== Interface ===
Right-clicking the '''Flex Helmet''' opens the following interface, which allows the player to select an animal skin.
{{/UI}}

The {{zone|Graveyard}} is home to {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s, which spawn in during the day, and more frequently at night. Additionally, {{MobSprite|Zombie Villager}}s that spawn exclusively and frequently at night.

The back of the '''Graveyard''' contains a launch pad to the {{zone|Spider's Den}}. There are also entrances to the {{Zone|Crypts}}, {{Zone|Catacombs Entrance}}, and {{Zone|Coal Mine}}.

The '''Half-Eaten Cave''' is a [[Location]] within the {{Zone|Village Plaza}} of the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Features ==
The entirety of the '''Half-Eaten Cave''' is filled with hay. This cannot be destroyed normally, and instead requires the player to shoot horses with a {{Item|Horsezooka}}. The hay re-grows, and can crush both the player and their rabbit.

If the player's rabbit is squashed, a message will appear, saying:

{{TextSection|boxed=true|text={{Dialogue|&4&l'''SPLASH!''' &cYour rabbit [Rabbit Name] has been squashed!}}}}

Additionally, if the player is squashed, they will lose {{Stat|Rift Time|60}} and be teleported to the entrance of the cave. The following message will appear:

The '''Heavy Pearl''' is a {{Legendary}} item that can be obtained as a drop by collecting them from [[The Matriarch]] in the [[Crimson Isle]].

== Obtaining ==
=== The Matriarch ===
'''Heavy Pearls''' can be obtained by collecting them from [[The Matriarch]]'s stomach, located in the {{Zone|Matriarch's Lair}}, without getting digested. There are three piles of '''Heavy Pearls''' in the {{zone|Belly of the Beast}}, which the player must click several times to obtain them. Whilst being in the {{zone|Belly of the Beast}}, {{Stat|hp}} is set to {{Stat|hp|100|icononly=yes}}, and all potion effects are removed. Under normal circumstances, {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=3}}s can be obtained per real-life day, all of which can be in the same run.

However, by consuming the {{Item|Matriarch's Perfume}}, players get to reset [[The Matriarch]] up to a total of four times per real-life day, thus allowing players to obtain up to {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=15}}s per real-life day. The {{Attr|Matriarch Cubs}} attribute, obtained from syphoning {{Item|Hellwisp Shard}}s, also increases the chance for an additional '''Heavy Pearl''' to be collected when obtaining one; when activated, the following text will display.

'''Honeyhives''' are structures in the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. They are the primary source of {{Item|Honeycomb}}.

== Overview ==
'''Honeyhives''' are found all across the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. They can be interacted with to obtain {{Item|Honeycomb}}. Additionally, the player has a chance to obtain {{Item|Enchanted Honeycomb}}, {{Coins}}, and a random bee-related [[Shard]]. The {{Item|Honeybuzz Shard}}'s {{Attr|Honey Haul}} attribute grants a chance to double the amount of {{Item|Honeycomb}} obtained.

A {{MobSprite|Honeybuzz}} has a {{Chance|50%|1|2}} chance<ref name="honeybuzz-chance" /> to spawn upon looting a '''Honeyhive'''. This yields the following message:

&e[NPC] Beth&f: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh... my... what is all of this?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThese aren't normal &acrops&f. These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
&8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
&e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7<player> &fhelp you.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7<player>&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust.
}}

§e[NPC] Beth§f: §fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

after the election has ended |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&cThis election has already ended!}} |} == On the Alpha Hypixel Network == Generally, when [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] opens, Mayor Elections are fully-functional and are held separately from the Main Server. === Mechanic === Mayor Elections on AHN run with the same principles, but independantly from those on the main server: * The results are counted separately, the candidates and their perks are picked separately. * The time that an Election starts and ends is in sync with the main server. * When the Alpha Hypixel Network is open, players can vote on its Mayor Election once per account (not per profile), regardless of whether they voted on the main server. ==== On an Alpha Network Reset ==== * At the time of a [[AHN#Alpha Network Reset|Network Reset]], {{NPCSprite|Mayor Nancy}} is the placeholder mayor for Alpha Hypixel Network until the next election. * If an election is supposed to be happening after a reset, the election feature will be disabled until the next election{{Confirm}}. See [[#Election Feature Disabled]]. ==== On a Session Opening ==== * When the Alpha Network closes and reopens without a Network Reset, all aspects of the Mayor Election will not be affected. * If an election is skipped during the downtime of the Alpha Network, it is unknown whether a random {{Blue|Regular}} candidate will be selected as mayor, or the previously elected mayor, or {{NPCSprite|Nancy}} being used as placeholder{{InfoNeeded}}. === Previous Elections === Due to the difficulty presented in recording Mayor Elections on the Alpha Hypixel Network which occasionally shuts down and reopens, it will be documented separately on [[Mayor Election/Alpha Hypixel Network]], and not integrated to the wiki's main table. == Features Disabled == === Mayor Disabled === There are some occasions during which a Mayor is disabled. This may happen when: * The previous mayor is not replaced after an election on a [[Hub]] server * The election feature is disabled on the Alpha Hypixel Network The following is the observed behavior: * When interacted, the "mayor" NPC will only give {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Mayor &f: Hello!!}} === Election Feature Disabled === On some occasions, the mayor election feature can be disabled on the Alpha Network. This is the observed behavior: * The Election Room is still present when votings happens in the main server. However, it will almost instantly teleport the player out when they attempt to get in. If there is enough ping, a player can interact with the NPCs and Ballot Box inside before it teleports you out. * Election is "closed". However, the timer outside the Election Room will still run in sync with the Main Server. * Ballot Box and Seraphine dialogue follows the version when election is closed. ** Attempting to click on the box in the middle of the {{zone|Election Room}} when the election is closed will show the message
